# svlang-lint Rule Catalog

<!-- Generated by tools/codegen/gen_rule_docs.py from the rules' own metadata. Do not edit. -->

**475 rules and sub-rules** across **5 domains**, **34 prefixes**, and **18 categories** using the strict 2-tier **`DOM-GRP-NNN`** (`3-3-3`) taxonomy.

- **Inspect any rule**: `svlang lint --explain <ID-or-Name>` prints the rule description, options, guidelines, and tested `bad.sv` / `good.sv` examples.
- **Select or waive by prefix wildcard**: `--rule 'RTL-*'`, `--rule 'SVL-CON-*,SVA-*'`, `svlang.lint.ignore: ["SVL-NAM-*", "UVM-NAM-*"]`, or inline `// svlang-lint:off SVL-STY-*`.
- **Machine-readable catalog**: `svlang lint --list-rules --json -` (published at [`catalog.json`](catalog.json)).

## Domains (`DOM-*`)

| Selector | Domain | Prefixes | Rules | Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | :--- |
| `CMP-*` | **Compiler** | `CMP-ERR` | 2 | IEEE 1800-2023 preprocessor, syntax, elaboration, and semantic diagnostics |
| `RTL-*` | **RTL Design** | `RTL-CDC`, `RTL-DAT`, `RTL-FSM`, `RTL-SYN` | 17 | Synthesizable RTL structure, FSM state reachability/deadlocks, CDC, and X-optimism/width hazards |
| `SVL-*` | **SystemVerilog** | `SVL-CON`, `SVL-COR`, `SVL-COV`, `SVL-DED`, `SVL-DEP`, `SVL-DPI`, `SVL-MNT`, `SVL-NAM`, `SVL-OOP`, `SVL-PRF`, `SVL-PRT`, `SVL-RND`, `SVL-SEC`, `SVL-STY`, `SVL-TYP`, `SVL-WVR` | 296 | Language correctness, types, DPI-C, OOP, concurrency, randomization, coverage, performance, dead code, maintainability, security, style, naming, and waivers |
| `SVA-*` | **Assertions & Formal** | `SVA-FPV`, `SVA-PRP` | 21 | Concurrent/immediate SVA properties, clocks, resets, action blocks, vacuity, and pre-FPV formal readiness |
| `UVM-*` | **IEEE 1800.2 UVM** | `UVM-CFG`, `UVM-CMP`, `UVM-DEP`, `UVM-FAC`, `UVM-NAM`, `UVM-OBJ`, `UVM-PHS`, `UVM-PRT`, `UVM-RAL`, `UVM-SEQ`, `UVM-TLM` | 139 | Factory, phasing, objections, uvm_config_db, sequences, TLM/scoreboards, component hierarchy/roles, RAL register models, and UVM naming/migration |

## Compiler

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`CMP-ERR-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/CMP-ERR-001) | CompilerError | ERROR | soundness |  | Reports the SystemVerilog compiler's errors (syntax, elaboration and type errors) as findings, so they appear in every report and in the editor next to the lint findings. |
| `CMP-ERR-002` | CompilerWarning | WARNING | soundness |  | Reports the SystemVerilog compiler's warnings as findings (controlled with -W options). (reported by `CMP-ERR-001`) |

## RTL

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`RTL-CDC-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-CDC-001) | UnsynchronizedCdcCrossing | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags multi-bit buses and unsynchronized or combinationally gated signals driven in one clock domain and sampled directly in another clock domain. |
| [`RTL-DAT-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-001) | CaseWithoutDefault | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'case', 'casex', and 'casez' statements that lack an explicit 'default:' fallback branch. |
| [`RTL-DAT-002`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-002) | CasexProhibited | ERROR | soundness | MG-6.3 | Disallows use of 'casex' statements. 'casex' treats unknown simulation 'x' values as wildcards, masking uninitialized logic bugs and timing errors. |
| [`RTL-DAT-003`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-003) | EqualityWithXz | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects equality ('==', '!=') checks against 4-state unknown literals ('x, 'z). Logical equality against unknowns evaluates to 'x (false in branch conditions), silently masking bugs. Use case equality ('===', '!==') instead. |
| [`RTL-DAT-004`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-004) | BitSelectOutOfBounds | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects static out-of-bounds bit or element selects on vectors and arrays with fixed ranges. SystemVerilog silently returns 'x for out-of-bounds accesses without crashing, causing silent data corruption. |
| [`RTL-DAT-005`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-005) | UnsizedLiteralInConcat | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallow unbased unsized integer literals inside concatenations ({1, 0, data}). Per IEEE 1800 § 11.4.12, unbased constants expand to 32 bits each, causing unintended vector widening. |
| [`RTL-DAT-006`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-DAT-006) | PartSelectReversed | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects reversed or inverted part-select slicing on vectors (e.g. vec[0:7] on logic [7:0] vec). Part-select slicing bounds must match the declared vector endianness. |
| [`RTL-FSM-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-FSM-001) | NonExhaustiveEnumCase | WARNING | soundness |  | Case statement switching over an enum type does not explicitly handle all declared enum variants while using a default: arm. Catch-all default arms silently swallow newly added specification states and mask FSM decoder bugs. |
| [`RTL-FSM-002`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-FSM-002) | FsmUnreachableState | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags declared FSM enum states that are neither entered on reset nor targeted by any state transition. |
| [`RTL-FSM-003`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-FSM-003) | FsmDeadlockState | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags non-reset, non-terminal FSM enum states whose case arm has no outgoing transition to any other state. |
| [`RTL-SYN-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-SYN-001) | MixedResetPolarity | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags modules whose sequential blocks mix posedge and negedge sensitivity on the same reset signal. |
| [`RTL-SYN-002`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-SYN-002) | PartialResetInAlwaysFf | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags asynchronous-reset always_ff blocks that reset some assigned registers in the reset branch while leaving other registers in the same block unreset. |
| [`RTL-SYN-003`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-SYN-003) | CombinationalClockOrResetGate | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags always_ff blocks clocked by a locally driven combinational expression rather than a primary clock or integrated clock-gating cell. |
| [`RTL-SYN-004`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-SYN-004) | PortWidthMismatch | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags module and interface instance port connections whose elaborated packed bit-width differs from the formal port's bit-width. |
| [`RTL-SYN-005`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/RTL-SYN-005) | InferredLatchInComb | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags signals or bit-slices driven inside always_comb that are not assigned on every symbolic execution path, inferring unintended level-sensitive latches. |
| `RTL-SYN-006` | ClockedBlockingRace | WARNING | soundness |  | A variable written with `=` in one edge-triggered always block and read by another on the same edge: a race (IEEE 1800 4.7). |
| [`RTL-SYN-007`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/RTL-SYN-007) | EventTriggerInAlwaysComb | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows event triggers ('->' or '->>') inside always_comb blocks (IEEE 1800 § 9.2.2.2). |

## Correctness

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-COR-001`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-001) | TautologicalCheckCompare | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects tautological comparison between identical expressions (e.g. 'act_pkt.data == act_pkt.data'). Self-comparisons in scoreboards and checks always evaluate to true, masking hardware bugs. |
| [`SVL-COR-002`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-002) | NonShortCircuitLogical | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows using bitwise AND ('&') or bitwise OR ('\|') instead of logical short-circuiting operators ('&&', '\|\|') inside conditional statements. |
| [`SVL-COR-003`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-003) | AssignmentInExpression | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows assignment expressions ('=' or compound assignments) inside conditional predicates or loop conditions. |
| [`SVL-COR-004`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-004) | SelfComparison | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows self-comparisons where an operand is compared to itself (e.g. a == a), which tautologically evaluates to constant true or false. |
| [`SVL-COR-005`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-005) | ModifyingLoopIndexInsideFor | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags modifications to the loop control variable inside a 'for' loop body. Mutating the loop index inside the body causes infinite loops, skipped iterations, and indexing errors. |
| [`SVL-COR-006`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-006) | ProceduralAssignmentAsSubExpression | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows embedded assignment expressions used as sub-expressions within conditionals or arithmetic operations. |
| [`SVL-COR-007`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-007) | OffByOneQueueIndex | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects out-of-bounds off-by-one queue and dynamic array indexing (e.g. 'q[q.size()]'). SystemVerilog silently returns uninitialized 'x/0 instead of raising an exception. |
| [`SVL-COR-008`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-008) | IdenticalBranches | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags if/else and case branches whose bodies are token-identical to an earlier branch of the same statement (clang-tidy bugprone-branch-clone, Sonar S1871). |
| [`SVL-COR-009`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-009) | RepeatedElseIfCondition | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags a condition that repeats an earlier condition of the same if/else-if chain, which makes the later branch dead (Sonar S1862). |
| [`SVL-COR-010`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-010) | SelfAssignment | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'x = x' assignments, typically a constructor or setter whose argument shadows the property it was meant to set (clang-tidy bugprone-self-assignment, Sonar S1656). |
| [`SVL-COR-011`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-011) | MismatchedFieldInCopyCompare | ERROR | soundness | MG-4.4 | In do_copy/do_compare and similar field-wise methods, flags a field of this object paired with a differently named field of the other object when the matching field exists. |
| [`SVL-COR-012`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-012) | IntegerDivisionToReal | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags integer divisions whose result is used as a real value, which truncates before the conversion (Sonar S2184, SpotBugs ICAST_IDIV_CAST_TO_DOUBLE). |
| [`SVL-COR-013`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-013) | RealEquality | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags == and != on real or shortreal operands, except against an exact zero (Sonar S1244, clang-tidy float equality). |
| [`SVL-COR-014`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-014) | SuspiciousArgumentOrder | WARNING | soundness | MG-2.4 | Flags positional calls where an argument's name matches a different parameter of the callee, such as write(len, addr) for write(addr, len) (clang-tidy readability-suspicious-call-argument, Sonar S2234). |
| [`SVL-COR-015`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-015) | MissingReturnPath | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags non-void functions where a control-flow path reaches the end of the function without executing a return statement or assigning the function return variable. |
| [`SVL-COR-016`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-016) | UninitializedLocalRead | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags automatic local scalar and handle variables in tasks and functions that are read before any write on all reaching paths. |
| [`SVL-COR-017`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-017) | UnwrittenOutputArgument | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags output arguments of concrete non-virtual tasks and functions that are never assigned anywhere in the body. |
| [`SVL-COR-018`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-018) | IntraAssignmentDelay | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows intra-assignment timing controls (e.g., a = #5 b; or a <= #5 b;) on procedural assignments. Intra-assignment delays cause simulation race conditions and are non-synthesizable. |
| [`SVL-COR-019`](../../testdata/rules/errors/SVL-COR-019) | FailureNotReported | ERROR | soundness | MG-8.1 | Flags randomize(), $cast(), uvm_config_db::get(), try_* and compare() status checks whose failure branch is empty or only reports below error severity (Sonar S108/S1166). |
| [`SVL-COR-020`](../../testdata/rules/errors/SVL-COR-020) | UseAfterFailedNullCheck | ERROR | soundness | MG-8.1 | Flags a handle that a null check, a failed uvm_config_db::get() or a failed $cast() showed to be null, dereferenced later on the same path because the failure branch did not stop (SpotBugs NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH). |
| [`SVL-COR-021`](../../testdata/rules/errors/SVL-COR-021) | ProcessTerminationInClass | WARNING | soundness | MG-8.1 | Flags $finish, $stop and $exit called from class methods. The run then skips the extract, check and report phases and the UVM report summary (Sonar S1147). |
| [`SVL-COR-022`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-022) | NonBlockingInFunction | ERROR | soundness |  | Prohibits non-blocking assignments ('<=') to variables inside functions: the update lands after the caller has moved on. Interface and clocking block drives are exempt (IEEE 1800 § 13.4.4 allows non-blocking assignments in functions). |
| [`SVL-COR-023`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-COR-023) | UnparenthesizedMacroArgument | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags expression macros that use an argument next to an operator without parentheses, or whose body is not wrapped in parentheses. `define DOUBLE(x) x*2 turns DOUBLE(a+1) into a+1*2; write `define DOUBLE(x) ((x)*2). |
| [`SVL-COR-024`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-COR-024) | FileHandleNotClosed | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags $fopen calls in classes that never call $fclose, which loses buffered trace data and exhausts file handles in long regressions (Sonar S2095). |
| [`SVL-COR-025`](../../testdata/rules/safety/SVL-COR-025) | StreamingConcatenationSizeMismatch | INFO | advisory |  | Flags streaming concatenation operators ({<< { ... }} / {>> { ... }}) omitting an explicit slice size (IEEE 1800 § 11.4.14.2). |
| [`SVL-COR-026`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-COR-026) | TimescalePrecisionMismatch | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags `timescale directives where the time precision is coarser than the time unit (IEEE 1800 § 3.14.2). |
| `SVL-COR-027` | MissingTimescaleInModule | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags files and modules containing procedural delays (#) that lack an explicit `timescale or timeunit declaration. |

## Types

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-TYP-001`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-001) | MixedSignComparison | WARNING | soundness |  | Comparing signed and unsigned integers causes implicit unsigned coercion of the signed operand. Negative values evaluate as huge positive numbers, causing comparisons to silently invert logic. |
| [`SVL-TYP-002`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-002) | RedundantCastToSameType | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags dynamic '$cast' calls or static type casts where the source and destination already have identical static types. |
| [`SVL-TYP-003`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-003) | ArrayLiteralSizeMismatch | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags positional array assignment patterns '{...} where the number of elements does not match the target fixed array dimension. |
| [`SVL-TYP-004`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-004) | TaskWithNonVoidReturnType | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows declaring tasks with explicit non-void return types. |
| [`SVL-TYP-005`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-005) | OutOfDomainEnumCast | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags static casts of constant integer literals into an enum type when the literal does not match any declared enumerator value. |
| [`SVL-TYP-006`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-006) | UnsignedLoopDowncountHazard | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags for-loops whose unsigned loop control variable is tested with '>= 0' while decrementing, causing infinite wrap-around execution. |
| [`SVL-TYP-007`](../../testdata/rules/types/SVL-TYP-007) | StructPatternFieldOrderMismatch | WARNING | style |  | Flags named struct assignment patterns whose explicit field keys appear out of declared struct member order or omit fields without a default: key. |
| [`SVL-TYP-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-TYP-008) | ImplicitEnumBaseType | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags enums in packages, classes and interfaces declared without a base type. They silently become 32-bit int, which wastes bits in packed items and no longer matches the width of the bus field they model (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-TYP-009`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-TYP-009) | LegacyIntegerType | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags the Verilog-1995 type 'integer' in class code. It is a 4-state 32-bit signed value; int (2-state) or an explicitly sized logic vector says what is meant (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default. |

## OOP

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-OOP-001`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-001) | NonVirtualMethodOverride | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.2 | Overriding a non-virtual method in a derived class breaks polymorphism when accessed via a base class handle. |
| [`SVL-OOP-002`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-002) | UncheckedDynamicCast | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | The return value of $cast(dest, src) must be checked (e.g., in an if statement or assert) to prevent silent null-pointer dereferences on cast failures. |
| [`SVL-OOP-003`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-003) | MissingSuperNew | WARNING | methodology |  | Constructors in derived classes should explicitly invoke super.new(...) to ensure base class state is initialized. |
| [`SVL-OOP-004`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-004) | VariableShadowing | WARNING | methodology |  | Detects variable shadowing where a derived class property shadows a base class property, or a method argument / local variable shadows a class member property. |
| [`SVL-OOP-005`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-005) | VirtualCallInConstructor | WARNING | methodology |  | Never call virtual methods inside constructors. In SystemVerilog, base constructors execute before child members are initialized, resulting in child methods operating on uninitialized data. |
| [`SVL-OOP-006`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-006) | ClassShallowCopyAliasing | ERROR | methodology |  | Using shallow copy (new other_obj) on classes containing nested object handles creates shared references across independent transactions. Use deep copy or clone() instead. |
| [`SVL-OOP-007`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-007) | NonVirtualInterfaceInClass | ERROR | methodology | MG-2.2 | Disallows declaring physical interface types inside classes without the 'virtual' keyword (IEEE 1800 § 25.9). |
| [`SVL-OOP-008`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-008) | EmptyVirtualMethodWithoutPure | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags virtual methods defined with empty bodies instead of being declared 'pure virtual' in abstract base classes. |
| [`SVL-OOP-009`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-009) | DowncastWithoutDynamicCast | ERROR | methodology |  | Flags static casting syntax (e.g. DerivedClass'(base_handle)) applied to class objects. SystemVerilog requires dynamic casting via $cast() to verify runtime polymorphism. |
| [`SVL-OOP-010`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-010) | ChainedAssignmentAliasing | WARNING | methodology |  | Disallows chained assignment expressions (e.g. a = b = c;). Chained assignments create dangerous reference aliasing across class handles. |
| [`SVL-OOP-011`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-011) | AbstractClassInstantiation | ERROR | methodology |  | Disallows direct instantiation of abstract (virtual) classes via 'new()'. Only concrete derived classes can be instantiated. |
| [`SVL-OOP-012`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-012) | SuperNewNotFirstStatement | WARNING | methodology |  | Derived class constructors calling super.new(...) must invoke it as the very first procedural statement. |
| [`SVL-OOP-013`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-013) | VirtualMethodSignatureMismatch | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.2 | Virtual method overrides in derived classes must match the parameter count and signature of the base virtual method. |
| [`SVL-OOP-014`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-014) | OverrideDefaultArgMismatch | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.2 | Flags virtual method overrides in derived classes that change or omit a default argument value declared on the base virtual method (IEEE 1800 § 8.20). |
| [`SVL-OOP-015`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-015) | TransitiveVirtualCallInNew | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags class constructors that call a non-virtual helper method on 'this' which transitively invokes a virtual method before derived class members are initialized. |
| [`SVL-OOP-016`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-016) | MissingSuperInDoHook | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags do_copy, do_compare, do_print, do_pack, and do_unpack overrides in derived user classes that omit super.do_*(), silently dropping base-class fields. |
| [`SVL-OOP-017`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-017) | MutableObjectGetterLeak | INFO | advisory | MG-2.1 | Flags getter functions (get_*()) returning direct handles to mutable internal uvm_object or data-class properties. |
| [`SVL-OOP-018`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-018) | LspConstraintContradiction | ERROR | methodology | MG-5.2 | Disallows unconditionally disabling inherited constraints via '.constraint_mode(0)' in derived classes. Disabling inherited constraints breaks base class contracts and violates the Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP). |
| [`SVL-OOP-019`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-019) | CastTypeInspectionLadder | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.2 | Disallows cascading $cast ladders (3+ branches) inspecting object types. Type inspection ladders violate the Open-Closed Principle (OCP); use virtual polymorphic methods instead. |
| [`SVL-OOP-020`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-OOP-020) | ForeachLoopVariableShadowing | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags loop index variables in 'foreach (arr[i])' loops that shadow an existing class property or routine local variable. |
| [`SVL-OOP-021`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-OOP-021) | TypeSwitchByName | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.2 | Flags branching on get_type_name() compared with string literals instead of virtual dispatch (Sonar 'instanceof chains', open/closed principle). |

## Concurrency

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-CON-001`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-001) | ConstantWaitCondition | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags 'wait()' statements with compile-time constant conditions (e.g., 'wait(0);', 'wait(1);'). 'wait(0);' deadlocks the simulation thread permanently, while 'wait(1);' executes instantaneously. |
| [`SVL-CON-002`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-002) | SemaphoreZeroKey | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags semaphore method calls (sem.get(0), sem.put(0), sem.try_get(0)) passing non-positive key counts (<= 0). |
| [`SVL-CON-003`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-003) | UnboundedMailboxInstantiation | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows instantiating unbounded mailboxes without a capacity limit to prevent memory bloat and missed producer-consumer synchronization. |
| [`SVL-CON-004`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-004) | MutexTryGetWithoutCheck | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags non-blocking semaphore or mutex try_get() calls whose return status is ignored, which risks threads executing critical sections without holding the lock. |
| [`SVL-CON-005`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-005) | WaitForkWithoutFork | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'wait fork;' statements in tasks or routines that contain no 'fork' blocks. Calling wait fork without spawning child processes can cause unintended hangs or dead code. |
| [`SVL-CON-006`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-006) | DisableForkWithoutScope | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows calling 'disable fork;' directly at task or routine scope without an enclosing isolating 'fork ... join' block. |
| [`SVL-CON-007`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-007) | WaitModifiedInLoop | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags wait(...) statements inside loops where condition variables are never modified or assigned inside the loop body. |
| [`SVL-CON-008`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-008) | ForkLoopVariableCapture | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows referencing loop variables directly inside 'fork ... join_none' or 'join_any' blocks without an automatic local variable copy. |
| [`SVL-CON-009`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-009) | BlockingEventTriggerInClockedBlock | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows blocking event triggers (-> ev) inside clocked blocks; non-blocking triggers (->> ev) should be used instead. |
| [`SVL-CON-010`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-010) | DisableNamedBlockInClass | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'disable <block>' and 'disable <task>' inside class methods. A named-block or task disable acts on every running copy, so stopping one agent's thread also stops the same thread in all other instances. 'disable fork' is not flagged. |
| [`SVL-CON-011`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-011) | UnguardedBlockingWait | WARNING | soundness |  | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags wait(vif.sig) and @(vif.sig) in drivers and sequences that are not raced against a timeout in fork ... join_any. Clock, reset and clocking-block events are not flagged, nor are tasks whose name says timeout or watchdog. Experimental: a watchdog elsewhere in the testbench may already cover the wait. |
| [`SVL-CON-012`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-012) | EventWaitVsTriggeredRace | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags @(ev) event waits inside fork...join_none or join_any child threads that race with active-region '-> ev' triggers, recommending wait(ev.triggered). |
| [`SVL-CON-013`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-013) | NbaToDynamicContainerOrHandle | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags non-blocking assignments ('<=') to local or module-scope dynamic arrays, queues, associative arrays, and strings (IEEE 1800 §10.4.2). |
| [`SVL-CON-014`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-014) | ForkJoinNoneRefOrOutputCapture | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags detached 'fork ... join_none' background threads that capture ref, const ref, output, or inout arguments whose caller lifetime may end before the child thread finishes. |
| [`SVL-CON-015`](../../testdata/rules/rtl_tb_bridge/SVL-CON-015) | ClockingBlockOutputReadSkew | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows reading output signals of a clocking block. Clocking block outputs are drive-only; reading them samples post-skew driven values with simulation race conditions. |
| [`SVL-CON-016`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-016) | CircularThreadWaitDeadlock | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects circular lock acquisition orders and wait-for dependency cycles across concurrent threads in fork..join blocks, which cause guaranteed or probabilistic simulation deadlocks. |
| [`SVL-CON-017`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-017) | PollingLoop | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags loops that test a flag or signal and wait a constant #delay between tests, instead of wait(), @ or an event (busy-wait smell, Sonar S2925). |
| [`SVL-CON-018`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-018) | SharedWriteFromForks | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags class properties written in two or more branches of one fork, or in a join_none thread and in its parent, without a semaphore (SpotBugs IS2_INCONSISTENT_SYNC). |
| [`SVL-CON-019`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-019) | RepeatLoopWithoutTiming | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags repeat loops inside testbench tasks that contain no time-consuming statements (#, @, wait). Zero-delay repeat loops in tasks spin instantaneously in a single delta cycle, often indicating missing clock synchronization. |
| [`SVL-CON-020`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-020) | ZeroTimeForeverLoop | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags forever loops whose body has no timing control, no task call and no exit, so the loop spins in zero simulation time and hangs the simulator. |
| [`SVL-CON-021`](../../testdata/rules/rtl_tb_bridge/SVL-CON-021) | DrivingDuringReset | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallow driving virtual interface control signals without an active reset check or synchronization guard. Asserting handshake signals during reset violates physical bus protocols and corrupts hardware state. |
| [`SVL-CON-022`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-022) | ZeroDelayEventWaitLoop | ERROR | soundness |  | Using wait(event.triggered) inside a loop without an intervening time-advancing delay (@ or #) causes a zero-delay infinite delta loop that hangs the simulator at 100% CPU. |
| [`SVL-CON-023`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-023) | ForkInsideFunction | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows spawning concurrent threads with 'fork ... join/join_any/join_none' inside functions. Functions must remain synchronous and instantaneous per IEEE 1800 § 13.4.4. |
| [`SVL-CON-024`](../../testdata/rules/rtl_tb_bridge/SVL-CON-024) | BlockingAssignmentToInterface | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows blocking assignments ('=') when driving virtual interface or clocking block signals. Clocking blocks and synchronous interface signals must be driven with non-blocking drives ('<=') per IEEE 1800 § 14.16. |
| [`SVL-CON-025`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-025) | TryPutIgnoredReturn | WARNING | soundness | MG-8.1 | Non-blocking IPC routines (try_put, try_get, try_peek) return a boolean status. Ignoring the return value silently drops transactions when queues are full or empty. |
| [`SVL-CON-026`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-026) | ZeroDelayEventTrigger | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags blocking event triggers ('-> event') where non-blocking triggers ('->> event') or 'wait(event.triggered)' avoid zero-delay active-region races. |
| [`SVL-CON-027`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-027) | LockNotReleased | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags semaphore get()/try_get() and sequencer lock()/grab() that some path leaves without the matching put()/unlock()/ungrab(), such as an early return (Sonar S2222). |
| [`SVL-CON-028`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-028) | ForkLoopVariableShared | ERROR | soundness |  | Spawning background threads with fork..join_none inside loops without copying the loop variable to an automatic local variable causes all threads to see the final loop index. |
| [`SVL-CON-029`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-029) | StaticRoutineVariableLifetime | WARNING | soundness |  | A task outside a class has static lifetime by default: its local variables are shared by every call that is running, so calls that overlap in time overwrite each other's values. Functions return in zero time and are not reported. |
| [`SVL-CON-030`](../../testdata/rules/concurrency/SVL-CON-030) | UnboundedThreadSpawn | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags fork ... join_none inside forever or while loops with no wait fork, disable fork or semaphore get in the loop to bound outstanding threads (thread-leak checks). |

## Randomization

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-RND-001`](../../testdata/rules/safety/SVL-RND-001) | UncheckedRandomize | ERROR | soundness | MG-8.1 | The return value of randomize() must be checked. Silently ignoring failure leaves transactions un-randomized or corrupt, concealing verification testbench bugs. |
| [`SVL-RND-002`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-002) | GlobalRngInClass | WARNING | soundness |  | Calling $urandom or $random inside class components or sequences corrupts global thread random stability. Use std::randomize() or object-scoped randomization to preserve simulation repeatability. |
| [`SVL-RND-003`](../../testdata/rules/safety/SVL-RND-003) | RandomizeMissingSuper | WARNING | soundness |  | Overridden pre_randomize() and post_randomize() callback methods must invoke super.pre_randomize() or super.post_randomize() to prevent bypassing base-class transaction setup and validation routines. |
| [`SVL-RND-004`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-004) | InlineShadowNoLocal | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects inline constraint variable shadowing inside 'randomize() with' missing 'local::'. Unqualified identifiers resolve to target object properties, turning constraints into no-op tautologies. |
| [`SVL-RND-005`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-005) | NonRandFieldConstrained | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects class member fields that are constrained in a constraint block but not declared 'rand' or 'randc'. The solver treats non-rand fields as fixed constants and will never randomize them. |
| [`SVL-RND-006`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-006) | RandcMemoryExplosion | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallow wide vector declarations with 'randc' (> 16 bits). Cyclic permutation tracking across large state spaces causes simulator heap exhaustion and solver startup deadlocks. |
| [`SVL-RND-007`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-007) | NonInvertibleConstraintOp | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallow non-invertible operators (%, /, **) inside constraint blocks. Non-linear operators prevent SAT/SMT solvers from bi-directionally pruning solution spaces, causing catastrophic backtracking and long simulation stalls. |
| [`SVL-RND-008`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-008) | StaticConstraint | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows static constraints. Static constraints share solver state across all class instances in the simulation, causing hidden dependencies and test flakiness. |
| [`SVL-RND-009`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-009) | CyclicSolveBefore | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects cyclic dependencies in solve...before constraint ordering (e.g. solve a before b and solve b before a). Cyclic solve-before constraints create an unsatisfiable dependency graph in the solver. |
| [`SVL-RND-010`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-010) | RedundantConstraint | WARNING | soundness | MG-7.1 | Detects duplicate or redundant constraint expressions within the same class scope. Redundant constraints enlarge solver expression graphs and increase solver solve latency without adding constraints. |
| [`SVL-RND-011`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-011) | ZeroWeightDistribution | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects constraint distribution blocks where all weights evaluate to zero. At least one weight in a distribution must evaluate to non-zero per IEEE 1800 § 18.5.4. |
| [`SVL-RND-012`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-012) | UnrestoredRandMode | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags '.rand_mode(0)' or '.constraint_mode(0)' calls that are never restored with '1' in the routine. Unrestored disabled random modes permanently corrupt stimulus generation for subsequent transactions. |
| [`SVL-RND-013`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-013) | EmptyRandomizeWith | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'randomize() with {}' containing an empty inline constraint block. Empty inline constraint blocks incur dynamic solver scope allocation overhead while adding no constraints. |
| [`SVL-RND-014`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-014) | UnconstrainedRandVariable | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags non-static 'rand' class properties that are never constrained in any constraint block within the class. |
| [`SVL-RND-015`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-015) | ConcurrentRandomizeInFork | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows concurrent calls to .randomize() on the same object handle across parallel fork threads without synchronization. |
| [`SVL-RND-016`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-016) | RandcStateExhaustion | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'randc' cyclic variables declared with bit-width <= 2 bits (1 or 2 bits). State permutation tables for <= 4 states reset almost immediately, incurring solver overhead with no benefit. |
| [`SVL-RND-017`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-017) | RandomizeInConstructor | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows calling randomize() inside class constructors (new()). Randomizing during construction breaks derived-class constraint inheritance and factory overrides. |
| [`SVL-RND-018`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-018) | ConstraintImplicationMultiBit | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags constraint implication expressions 'A -> B' where condition 'A' is a multi-bit vector without an explicit boolean comparison. |
| [`SVL-RND-019`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-019) | RandcInDynamicContainer | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows declaring 'randc' cyclic variables on dynamic arrays, queues, or associative arrays (IEEE 1800 § 18.4.1). |
| [`SVL-RND-020`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-020) | ConstraintInsideInvertedRange | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows inverted value ranges [low : high] where low > high in set membership expressions. |
| [`SVL-RND-021`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-021) | ConstraintCallingNonPureFunction | ERROR | soundness |  | Functions called in constraints must be pure and must not have side effects or void return types. |
| [`SVL-RND-022`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-022) | UnallocatedRandObjectArray | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags rand arrays of class handles whose elements are never created. randomize() sizes a dynamic array but does not construct objects, so every element stays null and its rand members are never randomized. |
| [`SVL-RND-023`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-023) | RandomizeInsideAssert | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags randomize() used as the condition of an immediate assert or assume. Turning assertions off also skips the randomization, so the object silently keeps stale values. |
| [`SVL-RND-024`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-024) | DistWideRangeColonEq | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags '[lo:hi] := w' in a dist when the range holds more than max_range_values (default 16) values and the dist also has items of another size. ':=' applies the weight to each value, which is rarely what the author meant; ':/' shares it. |
| [`SVL-RND-025`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-025) | UnrelatedSolveBefore | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'solve a before b' when no constraint of the class (or its base classes) ties a to b, directly or through other variables. The ordering then has no effect except to suggest a dependency that does not exist. |
| [`SVL-RND-026`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-026) | SoftConstraintShadowing | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags soft constraints whose winner is hard to predict: 'soft' inside an inline randomize() with { } block, and a soft constraint on a variable that a base class or another constraint block of the same class already constrains softly. Keep soft defaults in one place, in the base class, and override with hard constraints. |
| `SVL-RND-027` | ContradictoryConstraints | ERROR | soundness |  | A rand variable whose hard constraints leave no legal value (`len > 10` on a `bit [3:0]`; `x < 5` with `x inside {[8:9]}`). Bounds in different constraint blocks count together only when no user code calls `constraint_mode()`. |
| `SVL-RND-028` | SoftConstraintNeverHolds | WARNING | soundness |  | A `soft` constraint the class's hard constraints always override. |
| `SVL-RND-029` | DeadDistItem | WARNING | soundness |  | A `dist` item whose values the hard constraints or the type never allow, so its weight is dropped. |
| [`SVL-RND-030`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-030) | HardcodedBounds | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags non-soft literal constant bounds on rand properties in base classes (virtual classes or classes extended in the design), which prevent derived classes from widening stimulus ranges without constraint_mode(0). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-RND-031`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-031) | RelationalConstraintCycle | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags unconditional constraint blocks whose relational ordering predicates (<, <=, >, >=, ==) form a strict cycle across two or more variables (such as a < b && b < a), which is guaranteed unsatisfiable. |
| [`SVL-RND-032`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-032) | ForeachUnconstrainedArraySize | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags foreach loops in constraints over a rand dynamic array or queue whose .size() is never constrained in the class hierarchy and never pre-allocated in new() or pre_randomize(). |
| [`SVL-RND-033`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-033) | DanglingDisableSoft | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'disable soft <var>' directives in constraint blocks when neither the class nor any base class declares a soft constraint referencing <var>. |
| [`SVL-RND-034`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-034) | UniquePigeonholeOverflow | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags 'unique { arr }' constraints on fixed-size unpacked arrays whose element count exceeds the cardinality of the element integral type (pigeonhole overflow), making randomize() unsatisfiable. |
| [`SVL-RND-035`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-035) | RandModeInRandomizeCallback | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags mutating .rand_mode() or .constraint_mode() calls inside post_randomize(), where solver execution has already finished and mode mutations silently leak into subsequent randomize() calls. |
| [`SVL-RND-036`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-036) | SoftConstraintShadowedInSameClass | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags soft constraints on a rand property that are unconditionally shadowed by a hard constraint on the same property in the very same class. |
| [`SVL-RND-037`](../../testdata/rules/random/SVL-RND-037) | ConstantReseed | INFO | advisory |  | Flags srandom() or set_randstate() with a constant in components, sequences and other non-test classes; every seed of the regression then runs the same stimulus. Advisory: off by default. |

## Coverage

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-COV-001`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-001) | UnreferencedCovergroup | WARNING | soundness |  | Detects covergroups declared in classes or modules that are never instantiated with 'new()' or never sampled. Unreferenced covergroups contribute 0 coverage samples, creating silent verification blind spots. |
| [`SVL-COV-002`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-002) | ZeroWeightCoverpoint | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags covergroups, coverpoints, or crosses configured with option.weight or type_option.weight set to 0. Zero-weight coverage constructs collect samples but contribute 0% to regression coverage closure. |
| [`SVL-COV-003`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-003) | CrossSameCoverpoint | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects coverage cross constructs crossing a coverpoint with itself (cross cp_a, cp_a). Crossing a coverpoint with itself creates redundant diagonal bins that distort coverage calculation. |
| [`SVL-COV-004`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-004) | IllegalBinOverlap | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects overlapping values between regular 'bins' and 'illegal_bins' or 'ignore_bins' within a coverpoint. Per IEEE 1800 § 19.5, regular bins must not overlap with illegal or ignore bins. |
| [`SVL-COV-005`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-005) | UnboundedTransitionBins | WARNING | soundness |  | Transition sequences in coverpoint bins must not specify unbounded repetitions (e.g., [*1:$], [->1:$]). Unbounded transition sequences cause exponential memory growth in simulator coverage databases. |
| [`SVL-COV-006`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-006) | CovergroupCrossBinExplosion | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows crossing 3 or more coverpoints without 'ignore_bins' or 'binsof' exclusion filters. Unfiltered multi-way crosses cause combinatorial auto-bin explosion, leading to simulator memory exhaustion. |
| [`SVL-COV-007`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-007) | EmptyCovergroup | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags covergroups declared with zero coverpoints and zero crosses. An empty covergroup collects no coverage data. |
| [`SVL-COV-008`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-008) | CrossWithEmptyBins | WARNING | soundness |  | Detects degenerate covergroup cross constructs specifying fewer than 2 coverpoints or empty cross products. |
| [`SVL-COV-009`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-009) | CoverpointDefaultBinHazard | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags non-ignoring 'default' bins in coverpoints that mask uncovered stimulus and give a false sense of coverage closure. |
| [`SVL-COV-010`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-010) | CrossWithAllBinsIgnored | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags covergroup cross constructs where all defined bins are ignore_bins, producing vacuous 0-bin coverage metrics. |
| [`SVL-COV-011`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-011) | AtLeastZeroOrNegative | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags option.at_least or type_option.at_least set to 0 or negative values in covergroups/coverpoints. IEEE 1800 § 19.5 requires at_least to be a positive integer >= 1. |
| [`SVL-COV-012`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-012) | WideCoverpointWithoutBins | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags coverpoints that define no explicit bins and omit option.auto_bin_max. Default auto-binning creates 64 bins, producing misleading 100% coverage closure on wide vectors. |
| [`SVL-COV-013`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-013) | IgnoreBinsOverlapsIllegalBins | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags coverage models where the same value or range is specified in both 'ignore_bins' and 'illegal_bins' within a coverpoint. |
| [`SVL-COV-014`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-014) | CoverpointWeightZero | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags covergroups or coverpoints where 'option.weight' or 'type_option.weight' is set to 0, silently excluding it from coverage scores. |
| [`SVL-COV-015`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-015) | MissingIffOnCovergroupClock | WARNING | soundness |  | Covergroups sampled by a clocking event should specify an 'iff' reset guard condition. |
| [`SVL-COV-016`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-016) | OverlappingRangesInCoverpointBin | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags coverpoint bins containing overlapping numerical value ranges. |
| [`SVL-COV-017`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-017) | UnreachableCoverBin | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags coverpoint bins whose values all lie outside the range of the coverpoint expression (for example bins {[16:31]} on a 4-bit value). Such a bin can never be hit. |
| `SVL-COV-018` | CrossBinCountTooLarge | WARNING | soundness |  | A cross whose bin count, computed as a simulator builds the bins (explicit, `[N]`, `[]`, automatic up to `auto_bin_max`), is above 10,000. |
| `SVL-COV-019` | CovergroupNeverSampled | WARNING | soundness |  | A covergroup declared in a module, interface, program or package with no sampling event that nothing instantiates, or whose instances no `.sample()` call anywhere in the design targets (`cg_i.sample()`, `bus.cg_i.sample()`, `cg_q[i].sample(x)`). The class covergroups are SVL-COV-001's. Quiet on the corpus, whose module and interface covergroups all have a clocking event. |
| [`SVL-COV-020`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-020) | MissingPerInstanceOption | INFO | advisory |  | Flags covergroups declared in uvm_component subclasses that omit 'option.per_instance = 1;', merging multi-instance coverage into type-level bins only. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-COV-021`](../../testdata/rules/coverage/SVL-COV-021) | PerInstanceZeroOnClassCovergroup | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags covergroups declared in classes or parameterized modules/interfaces that explicitly set 'option.per_instance = 0;', collapsing per-instance coverage holes. |

## SVA

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVA-FPV-001`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-FPV-001) | AssumeOnOutputOrState | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags formal 'assume' statements that constrain module output ports or internal sequential state rather than primary inputs, which silently masks reachable DUT bugs. |
| [`SVA-FPV-002`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-FPV-002) | ResetlessFlopFeedsControl | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags reset-less sequential flip-flops whose outputs feed 1-bit control/handshake ports, memory write-enables, or mux selectors in modules with reset logic. |
| [`SVA-FPV-003`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-FPV-003) | FormalAssertMissingDisableIff | INFO | advisory |  | Flags concurrent 'assert' and 'cover' properties without 'disable iff' (and no 'default disable iff') inside elaborated modules that use reset. Advisory: selected by '--guideline formal-ready' or '--preset formal-ready'. |
| [`SVA-FPV-004`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-FPV-004) | UnboxedWideArithOrMemory | INFO | advisory |  | Flags wide variable-by-variable multipliers/dividers (>= min_arith_width, default 16 bits) and large memories (>= min_mem_words, default 256 words) in formal-checked modules that should be black-boxed ('-bbox_mul' / '-bbox_a'). Advisory: selected by '--guideline formal-ready' or '--preset formal-ready'. |
| [`SVA-FPV-005`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-FPV-005) | ConstantOrContradictoryAssume | ERROR | soundness |  | Flags constant-false, tautological constant-true, or pairwise-contradictory formal 'assume' statements that render the formal environment vacuous or redundant. |
| [`SVA-PRP-001`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-001) | ImmediateAssertInCombinatorialLogic | WARNING | soundness |  | Simple immediate assertions in always_comb or combinatorial blocks evaluate transient delta glitches. Convert to deferred immediate assertions (assert #0 or assert final) to wait for settled circuit values. |
| [`SVA-PRP-002`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-002) | DisableIffComplexExpression | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags 'disable iff (...)' clauses containing complex boolean expressions or multi-variable logic instead of simple reset conditions. |
| [`SVA-PRP-003`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-003) | MixedClockEdgesInProperty | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags SVA properties or assertions that mix both 'posedge' and 'negedge' clocking events. |
| [`SVA-PRP-004`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-004) | NonConsecutiveRepetitionZeroBound | ERROR | soundness |  | Non-consecutive repetition operators ([= ...] and [-> ...]) must specify a minimum bound >= 1. |
| [`SVA-PRP-005`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-005) | MultiClockConcurrentAssertionDomain | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallows concurrent assertions mixing multiple asynchronous clock domains without formal CDC qualification. |
| [`SVA-PRP-006`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-006) | ComplexInlineProperty | INFO | advisory |  | Flags assert/assume/cover property statements whose inline property uses more than max_temporal_ops (default 3) temporal operators (##, \|->, \|=>, [*], throughout, within, until, ...). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVA-PRP-007`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-007) | ImplicationInCoverProperty | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags cover property statements that use implication ('\|->' or '\|=>'), which succeed vacuously whenever the antecedent is false instead of covering sequence completion. |
| [`SVA-PRP-008`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-008) | AssertWithoutElse | WARNING | style | MG-8.1 | Immediate and concurrent assertions must include an 'else' action block (e.g. 'else `uvm_error(...)'). Assertions without action blocks produce unhelpful one-line messages and cannot integrate with UVM reporting. |
| [`SVA-PRP-009`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-009) | TimeInAssertionAction | ERROR | soundness |  | Action blocks of immediate and concurrent assertions must not consume simulation time (# delays, @ event controls, or wait statements) per IEEE 1800 § 16. |
| [`SVA-PRP-010`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-010) | SideEffectInAssertionAction | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags assignments, increments and other writes inside the pass or fail action of an immediate or concurrent assertion. Reporting calls are fine; state changes vanish when assertions are disabled. |
| [`SVA-PRP-011`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-011) | ConcurrentAssertInFunction | ERROR | soundness |  | Disallow concurrent assertions ('assert/assume/cover property') inside functions. Functions execute in zero simulation time and lack clocking contexts required by SVA semantics. |
| [`SVA-PRP-012`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-012) | SvaUnboundedDelay | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags unbounded cycle delays (##[1:$]) in SVA sequences where bounded delays improve simulation memory use and formal convergence. |
| [`SVA-PRP-013`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-013) | UnlabeledAssertion | WARNING | style |  | Immediate and concurrent assertions must declare an explicit label prefix (e.g. 'check_lbl: assert ...'). Lacking labels makes regression failure triage, ticket routing, and assertion control commands difficult. |
| [`SVA-PRP-014`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-014) | DisableIffReset | WARNING | advisory |  | Concurrent assertions and property declarations should include a 'disable iff (...)' reset guard (unless covered by default disable iff or the paired property/assertion). |
| [`SVA-PRP-015`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SVA-PRP-015) | SvaVacuousAntecedent | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects constant-false antecedents in assertion implications (0 \|-> ...). False antecedents cause vacuous passes, giving a false 100% pass metric while never verifying DUT behavior. |
| [`SVA-PRP-016`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVA-PRP-016) | InterfaceWithoutAssertions | INFO | advisory | MG-8.2 | Flags an interface with clocking blocks or modports, so a protocol interface, that holds no assertions (assert/assume/cover property, immediate asserts, property declarations or checkers) and is not the target of a bind. Every bench that reuses it then re-checks the protocol by hand, or not at all (design by contract; MG-8.2). Advisory: off by default. |

## UVM

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`UVM-CFG-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-001) | UvmConfigDbTypeMismatch | ERROR | methodology | MG-2.4 | The type parameter in uvm_config_db#(T)::get must match the type parameter used in the corresponding set call for the same field name. |
| [`UVM-CFG-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-002) | UvmConfigDbNullContext | WARNING | methodology |  | Passing 'null' as context to uvm_config_db inside a uvm_component breaks hierarchical scoping and prevents targeted configuration overrides. Use 'this' instead. |
| [`UVM-CFG-003`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-003) | UvmConfigDbGlobalWildcard | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Calling uvm_config_db::set(null, "*", ...) with a null context and a bare wildcard or empty scope triggers global regex matching across every component in the testbench, severely degrading simulation startup. |
| [`UVM-CFG-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-004) | ConfigDbGetUnchecked | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags calls to 'uvm_config_db#(...)::get()' where the boolean return status is ignored without being checked in an 'if' condition or assertion. |
| [`UVM-CFG-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-005) | ConfigDbCrossComponentResolver | ERROR | methodology | MG-2.3 | Performs cross-component semantic resolution on uvm_config_db calls across the testbench hierarchy DAG to detect configuration type mismatches between set() and get() calls. |
| [`UVM-CFG-006`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-006) | PlusargsOutsideTest | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Flags $test$plusargs, $value$plusargs and uvm_cmdline_processor reads in classes other than tests and config objects. Reading the command line deep inside components is hidden global configuration. |
| [`UVM-CFG-007`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-007) | ConfigDbAsRuntimeChannel | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Flags uvm_config_db get, set, exists and wait_modified calls in the run-time phases of components and inside loops of any task. config_db is build-time wiring; used at run time it becomes a slow global mailbox (common coupling, MG-2.3). |
| [`UVM-CFG-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-008) | ScatteredConfigKeyLiteral | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.4 | Flags a uvm_config_db field name typed as a string literal in two or more files. The setter and getter only meet if both spell it the same; a shared constant makes the compiler check that (connascence of name, MG-2.4). Reported once per name. |
| [`UVM-CFG-009`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-009) | SharedConfigMutatedAtRuntime | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Flags writes to fields of a config object that the class got from uvm_config_db and did not create, made outside new() and the build phases. The object is shared by everyone who read it, so the write is hidden global state (common coupling, MG-2.3). |
| [`UVM-CFG-010`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-010) | ConfigDbGetWithoutSet | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.4 | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags a uvm_config_db::get whose string field name has no set in this compilation, when the compilation contains both sets and gets. Experimental: a set in a file that was not linted, or a field name built at run time, is invisible here. |
| [`UVM-CFG-011`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-011) | ConfigDbSetNeverGot | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.4 | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags a uvm_config_db::set whose string field name has no get in this compilation, when the compilation contains both sets and gets. Experimental: a get in a file that was not linted, or a field name built at run time, is invisible here. |
| [`UVM-CFG-012`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-012) | UvmDanglingConfigString | ERROR | soundness, methodology | MG-2.4 | Static UVM component DAG path matching: detects glob strings in uvm_config_db::set() that match zero instantiated components in the verification hierarchy. Typographical errors in string paths cause configurations to be silently dropped. |
| [`UVM-CFG-013`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CFG-013) | ConfigDbGetInRunPhaseLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Flags uvm_config_db::get() calls inside loops in runtime task phases or sequence body() tasks, which scan the global resource table on every iteration. |
| [`UVM-CFG-014`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-014) | AgentWithoutConfigObject | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.2 | Flags agents and envs that read three or more separate scalar settings from uvm_config_db instead of one config object (Fowler 'data clumps', MG-4.2). |
| [`UVM-CFG-015`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CFG-015) | AbsoluteConfigDbPath | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.3 | Flags uvm_config_db calls in classes whose path starts at uvm_test_top. Below the test the path should be relative to 'this'; with a non-null context an absolute path is appended to the context and never matches (MG-4.3). |
| [`UVM-CMP-001`](../../testdata/rules/design/UVM-CMP-001) | LayerDependency | WARNING | methodology | MG-1.1 | Flags classes that depend on a higher testbench layer (item < sequence < agent < env < test), such as a sequence that references a scoreboard or an agent that references the env (ArchUnit layer rules). |
| [`UVM-CMP-002`](../../testdata/rules/design/UVM-CMP-002) | HierarchyReachThrough | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Flags expressions that reach through three or more component handles (env.agt.drv.vif), outside connect_phase wiring (PMD LawOfDemeter, Fowler 'message chains'). |
| [`UVM-CMP-003`](../../testdata/rules/design/UVM-CMP-003) | FileIncludedInMultiplePackages | ERROR | methodology | MG-1.3 | Flags a file whose class definitions are `include'd into more than one package. Each package gets its own, incompatible type with the same name (C++ one-definition rule). |
| [`UVM-CMP-004`](../../testdata/rules/design/UVM-CMP-004) | StringHierarchyLookup | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Flags uvm_root/uvm_component find(), find_all() and lookup() calls outside tests and end_of_elaboration_phase. Looking components up by path string is a service locator that hides dependencies and breaks silently when the hierarchy changes. |
| [`UVM-CMP-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CMP-005) | UnregisteredUvmCallback | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags uvm_callbacks#(T, CB)::add calls where the callback class CB lacks a matching `uvm_register_cb(T, CB) registration. |
| [`UVM-CMP-006`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-006) | HandleToEnvOrTest | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Flags sequences, items, agents, config objects and helpers that store a handle to a user env or test class. They then depend on everything the env contains and cannot be used under another env (stamp coupling, dependency inversion, MG-2.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-007`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-007) | ForeignComponentStateWrite | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Flags assignments to properties of another component through a handle, except a parent setting up its own subtree in new() and the build, connect and end_of_elaboration phases (content coupling, MG-2.1). UVM-CMP-002 covers long read chains. |
| [`UVM-CMP-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-008) | HierarchicalReferenceInClass | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.2 | Flags class code that names a module hierarchy (tb_top.dut.sig, $root.tb.x). Classes must reach the DUT only through virtual interfaces so they stay reusable (information hiding, MG-2.2). |
| [`UVM-CMP-009`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CMP-009) | ProhibitedDisplayInUvm | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Disallow direct $display/$write/$strobe calls inside UVM classes (components, objects, sequences). SystemVerilog display tasks bypass UVM reporting infrastructure, log redirection, and verbosity filtering. |
| [`UVM-CMP-010`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-010) | CallbackNotRegistered | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Flags `uvm_do_callbacks(T, CB, ...) in classes where no `uvm_register_cb(T, CB) registers that pair for T or a base of T. UVM then refuses to add callbacks of that type at run time, so the hook never fires (MG-5.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-011`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-011) | HandRolledSingleton | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.3 | Flags a class that keeps a static variable of its own type, the usual hand-rolled singleton. Every env and test in the run shares that one object, and a test cannot replace it. Pass the object through uvm_config_db or the resource database (MG-5.3). |
| [`UVM-CMP-012`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-012) | NoExtensionPoint | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags a driver or monitor whose run_phase is long (25 statements or more; option min_statements) while the class and its user bases declare no virtual hook methods and use no callbacks. A test or derived agent cannot then change one step, such as error injection or timing, without copying the whole run_phase (MG-5.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`UVM-CMP-013`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CMP-013) | LowVerbosityDebugReport | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags UVM debug or trace messages configured with low verbosity (UVM_LOW or UVM_NONE). |
| [`UVM-CMP-014`](../../testdata/rules/errors/UVM-CMP-014) | BlanketErrorDemotion | ERROR | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags report catchers that demote or swallow errors without filtering on ID or message, and severity overrides/actions that disable UVM_ERROR or UVM_FATAL for every ID (Pylint W0718 broad-exception-caught). |
| [`UVM-CMP-015`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-015) | CheckFailureAsWarning | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags a failed compare() or an expected-versus-actual mismatch reported only with `uvm_warning or `uvm_info. The test still passes; check failures must be errors so they are counted (MG-8.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-016`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-016) | FatalInCheckerPath | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags `uvm_fatal on a data mismatch in scoreboards and subscribers. The run stops at the first mismatch and hides how many others there are; use `uvm_error and let max_quit_count stop the run (MG-8.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-017`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-017) | InfoAtNoneVerbosity | INFO | methodology |  | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags `uvm_info messages at UVM_NONE verbosity, which cannot be filtered with +UVM_VERBOSITY. Experimental: measuring how often real benches use UVM_NONE on purpose. |
| [`UVM-CMP-018`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-018) | DriverGeneratesStimulus | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Flags drivers that randomize sequence items or start sequences. Stimulus belongs in sequences, where tests can layer constraints and the sequencer can arbitrate; a driver only converts items to pin activity (single responsibility, MG-3.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-019`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-019) | CoverageOutsideObservers | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Flags covergroups declared in drivers and sequences. They sample what was intended, not what reached the DUT, and disappear when the agent is passive; collect coverage in a monitor or subscriber (MG-3.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-020`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-020) | DutCheckingInAgent | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.2 | Flags agents that hold a scoreboard, predictor or reference model. Agents carry protocol knowledge only; DUT-specific checking belongs in the env so the agent can be reused with other DUTs (MG-3.2). |
| [`UVM-CMP-021`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-021) | TestBuildsLeafComponents | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.3 | Flags tests that create drivers, monitors, sequencers, agents, scoreboards or subscribers directly. Tests configure and select; the env builds, so every test shares one structure (facade, MG-3.3). |
| [`UVM-CMP-022`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-022) | MonitorDependsOnActivePath | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Flags monitors that hold a handle to a driver, sequencer or sequence item port. A monitor must work on its own, observing only the interface, or it breaks in passive agents (MG-3.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-023`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-023) | VirtualInterfaceInChecker | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags virtual interface handles in scoreboards and subscribers. Pin timing belongs in drivers, monitors and interface assertions; a checker that waits on signals cannot run against a transaction-level model or an emulator, and hides a second monitor. Sequences are covered by UVM-SEQ-001. |
| [`UVM-CMP-024`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-024) | ProceduralTimeoutInMonitor | INFO | advisory |  | Flags fork ... join_any blocks in a monitor where one branch counts clock cycles (repeat (N) @(...)) and then reports an error: a handshake timeout written as procedural code. A concurrent assertion in the interface states the same rule in one line and checks it every cycle. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`UVM-CMP-025`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-025) | AgentIgnoresIsActive | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.1 | Flags agents that create their driver or sequencer without checking is_active or get_is_active(). Such an agent cannot be reused as a passive monitor in a larger env (MG-4.1). |
| [`UVM-CMP-026`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-CMP-026) | HardcodedTopology | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.2 | Flags envs that create components in a loop with a literal count instead of a count from their config object (open/closed principle, MG-4.2). |
| [`UVM-CMP-027`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CMP-027) | ComponentNameMismatch | ERROR | methodology |  | Disallows passing hardcoded string literals to super.new() in uvm_component constructors. The constructor must forward the 'name' argument so the UVM factory can assign distinct instance names. |
| [`UVM-CMP-028`](../../testdata/rules/oop/UVM-CMP-028) | StaticMemberInUvmComponent | ERROR | methodology | MG-2.3 | Non-const static variable declared in a uvm_component subclass is shared across all instances simulation-wide. In multi-channel or multi-agent environments, instances will overwrite each other's state. |
| [`UVM-CMP-029`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-CMP-029) | VirtualInterfaceModportDriveInversion | ERROR | methodology | MG-3.1 | Detects procedural signal driving (via '=' or '<=') on virtual interface handles inside passive uvm_monitor components. Monitors must remain purely passive observers to avoid multi-driver electrical contention and X-propagation. |
| [`UVM-FAC-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-001) | UvmComponentDirectNew | ERROR | methodology | MG-4.5 | UVM components must be created using the UVM factory (type_name::type_id::create) instead of direct new() calls to support testbench overrides. |
| [`UVM-FAC-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-002) | UvmFactoryMacroMismatch | ERROR | methodology | MG-4.5 | Classes derived from uvm_component must use `uvm_component_utils, and classes derived from uvm_object (non-component) must use `uvm_object_utils. |
| [`UVM-FAC-003`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-003) | UvmFactoryMissingUtils | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.5 | Concrete classes derived from uvm_object or uvm_component must declare factory registration macros (`uvm_component_utils / `uvm_object_utils). |
| [`UVM-FAC-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-004) | ParameterizedClassFactoryRegistration | ERROR | methodology | MG-4.5 | Parameterized UVM components and objects must use `uvm_component_param_utils or `uvm_object_param_utils instead of non-parameterized utils macros. |
| [`UVM-FAC-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-005) | GlobalFactoryOverridePollution | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.5 | Flags global factory type overrides (set_type_override, set_type_override_by_type, factory.set_type_override_by_name, T::type_id::set_type_override) outside uvm_test classes. They change the type for every test and VIP in the simulation; reusable components and sequences should use instance overrides scoped to their sub-tree. |
| [`UVM-FAC-006`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-006) | IncompatibleFactoryOverride | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.5 | Flags type-based UVM factory overrides (set_type_override_by_type, set_inst_override_by_type, type_id::set_type_override) where the override class does not extend the requested base class. |
| [`UVM-FAC-007`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-FAC-007) | ComponentNullParentInCreate | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.5 | Flags UVM component factory create calls passing 'null' as the parent handle, creating orphaned hierarchy nodes. |
| [`UVM-FAC-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-FAC-008) | OverrideByNameString | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.3 | Flags factory overrides and creates that name types with string literals (set_type_override_by_name, set_inst_override, create_object ...). A typo or rename is only found at run time; T::type_id::set_type_override() is checked by the compiler (connascence of name, MG-4.3). |
| [`UVM-OBJ-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-OBJ-001) | UvmUnpairedObjection | ERROR | methodology |  | Every phase.raise_objection() call must have a corresponding phase.drop_objection() within the same execution context to prevent simulation hangs or fatal errors. |
| [`UVM-OBJ-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-OBJ-002) | UvmObjectionInLoop | WARNING | methodology |  | Avoid raising and dropping objections inside high-frequency transaction loops to prevent severe simulation performance degradation. |
| [`UVM-OBJ-003`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-OBJ-003) | ObjectionControlFlowMismatch | ERROR | methodology |  | Performs control-flow graph (CFG) analysis on UVM phase and task routines to verify that every execution path containing raise_objection() is strictly guaranteed to reach a matching drop_objection() without early returns or asymmetric conditional branching. |
| [`UVM-OBJ-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-OBJ-004) | OrphanSubsequenceObjectionHang | ERROR | methodology |  | Detects background processes launched via fork..join_none inside UVM sequences that raise objections without a deterministic drop path, leaving orphan objections that hang simulation phases. |
| [`UVM-OBJ-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-OBJ-005) | ObjectionWithoutDescription | INFO | methodology |  | Flags raise_objection()/drop_objection() on a phase or objection with no description or an empty one. A short description makes objection traces of a hung test readable. |
| [`UVM-OBJ-006`](../../testdata/rules/errors/UVM-OBJ-006) | FixedDelayBeforeDrop | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags a constant #delay immediately before drop_objection(), used to let traffic drain (xUnit 'sleepy test', Sonar S2925). |
| [`UVM-PHS-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-001) | UvmMissingSuperPhase | WARNING | methodology |  | Overridden standard UVM phases (e.g., build_phase, connect_phase) in uvm_component must call super.<phase_name>(phase) to ensure proper base-class configuration. |
| [`UVM-PHS-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-002) | UvmTimeInFunctionPhase | ERROR | methodology |  | Function-based UVM phases (e.g., build_phase, connect_phase) must not consume simulation time using delays (#), event controls (@), or wait statements. |
| [`UVM-PHS-003`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-003) | UvmPhaseSignatureMismatch | ERROR | methodology |  | Standard UVM phase methods must declare correct signatures (function void vs task, and a single argument of type uvm_phase). |
| `UVM-PHS-004` | SequenceInFunctionPhase | ERROR | methodology |  | Disallow starting sequences (.start()) inside zero-time function phases (build_phase, connect_phase, etc.). Sequences require time-consuming simulation events and must be executed in task phases. |
| [`UVM-PHS-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-005) | SuperBuildPhaseOrder | WARNING | methodology |  | Enforces that super.build_phase(phase) is the very first procedural statement in build_phase. Top-down phasing requires base class build_phase to execute before derived class configuration logic. |
| [`UVM-PHS-006`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-006) | PhaseObjectionMismatch | ERROR | methodology |  | Detects 'phase.raise_objection()' calls without a matching 'phase.drop_objection()' in the same task or method. Unpaired objections prevent UVM phases from terminating, causing simulation hangs. |
| [`UVM-PHS-007`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-007) | UvmPhaseJumpHazard | WARNING | methodology |  | Disallows manual phase jumping ('phase.jump(...)') in UVM testbenches due to objection leaks and scoreboard desynchronization risks. |
| [`UVM-PHS-008`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-008) | TimeInNonTimePhase | ERROR | methodology |  | Disallows time-consuming statements (#, @, wait, ##) inside non-time-consuming UVM phases (e.g. build_phase, connect_phase, check_phase). |
| [`UVM-PHS-009`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-009) | ObjectionInNonRunPhase | ERROR | methodology |  | Disallows calling raise_objection() or drop_objection() inside non-run function phases (e.g. build_phase, connect_phase). Objections are strictly reserved for runtime phases. |
| [`UVM-PHS-010`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-010) | BuildPhaseCrossComponentAccess | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Detects direct access to sibling components or cross-component handles during build_phase. Because the execution order of build_phase among sibling components is undefined in UVM, referencing sibling state during build_phase results in non-deterministic initialization races. |
| [`UVM-PHS-011`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-011) | RunPhaseWithRuntimePhases | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags a component that overrides run_phase and also one of the runtime sub-phases (reset, configure, main, shutdown and their pre_/post_ phases). run_phase runs in parallel with all of them, so the two schedules race and readers cannot tell the order. |
| [`UVM-PHS-012`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-012) | MismatchedSuperPhaseCall | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags overridden UVM component phase methods that invoke super.<other_phase>(phase) instead of super.<same_phase>(phase). |
| [`UVM-PHS-013`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PHS-013) | VirtualInterfaceAccessInBuildPhase | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.2 | Flags reading or driving virtual interface signals inside new() or build_phase() (or helpers called from them) before connect_phase / run_phase. |
| [`UVM-RAL-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-001) | DirectMirrorSetWithoutWrite | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags direct reg.set(...) calls that update only software mirrors without issuing physical DUT write transactions. |
| [`UVM-RAL-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-002) | MissingBackdoorAccessPathDefinition | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags RAL backdoor path configuration routines called with an empty string or null path. |
| [`UVM-RAL-003`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-RAL-003) | IncompleteRegAdapter | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Flags uvm_reg_adapter subclasses whose bus2reg() never sets rw.status or whose reg2bus() never reads rw.kind. The register layer then reports every access as passed, or turns reads into writes (adapter pattern, MG-5.1). |
| [`UVM-RAL-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-004) | RegBlockNeverLocked | ERROR | methodology |  | Flags a top-level register block (held by an env or test, not by another block) on which lock_model() is never called. Until the model is locked, address maps are not built, so frontdoor accesses and get_reg_by_offset() fail. |
| [`UVM-RAL-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-005) | RalAddressCollision | ERROR | methodology |  | Detects duplicate/overlapping address offsets mapped in uvm_reg_block address maps. Address collisions cause silent register overwriting and hardware aliasing bugs. |
| [`UVM-RAL-006`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-006) | RalFieldBitOverlap | WARNING | methodology |  | Detects overlapping [lsb_pos : lsb_pos + size - 1] bit ranges across uvm_reg_field::configure() calls within the same uvm_reg::build() method. |
| [`UVM-RAL-007`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-007) | RalOrphanRegister | ERROR | methodology |  | Detects instantiated uvm_reg instances inside uvm_reg_block that are never mapped via default_map.add_reg(). Orphan registers cause frontdoor access failures and verify phantom memory. |
| [`UVM-RAL-008`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-008) | RalMapAddressIntervalOverlap | ERROR | methodology |  | Detects 1D address interval overlaps and register aliasing collisions within the same uvm_reg_map in a uvm_reg_block, preventing silent register corruption in hardware. |
| [`UVM-RAL-009`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-RAL-009) | RalPredictorAdapterWiring | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Verifies that all instantiated uvm_reg_predictor components have their .map property assigned in connect_phase. Without a map binding, explicit register prediction fails silently and register mirror values will never be updated during simulation. |
| [`UVM-RAL-010`](../../testdata/rules/oop/UVM-RAL-010) | DirectRalMirrorTampering | ERROR | methodology |  | Direct assignment to internal RAL fields (m_value, m_mirrored, m_desired) bypasses register callbacks, access policy checks, and prediction pipelines. Use predict() or bus operations instead. |
