| [`UVM-SEQ-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-001) | UvmSequenceDirectVifAccess | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Sequences and sequence items must not directly declare or drive virtual interface signals. Signal-level driving is the sole responsibility of the driver. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-002`](../../testdata/rules/oop/UVM-SEQ-002) | UvmSequencePrePostBodyMisuse | WARNING | methodology |  | pre_body() and post_body() callbacks in uvm_sequence are explicitly bypassed when the sequence is executed as a child sequence via `uvm_do or `uvm_do_with. Use pre_start() / post_start() or body() instead. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-003`](../../testdata/rules/oop/UVM-SEQ-003) | UvmPSequencerAbuse | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Using `uvm_declare_p_sequencer or accessing p_sequencer violates the Law of Demeter by tightly coupling the sequence data tier to physical sequencer component internals. Pass configuration down through sequence fields or uvm_config_db. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-004) | SequenceAbortSafety | ERROR | soundness, methodology |  | Detects calls to start_item() in UVM sequences that can bypass finish_item() via early return or break statements. An aborted sequence without finish_item() permanently deadlocks the sequencer's grant-wait queue. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-005) | EmptySequenceBody | WARNING | methodology |  | Detects sequence classes whose body() task contains no executable statements. Empty sequence bodies generate zero stimulus transactions. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-006`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-006) | UncheckedGetResponse | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags calls to get_response() in UVM sequences. Calling get_response() requires the driver to actively provide response items; otherwise, the sequencer response FIFO remains empty and deadlocks simulation. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-007`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-007) | SequencePriorityRange | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags sequence start() calls passing invalid negative priority values (< -1) which corrupt sequencer arbitration. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-008`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-008) | SequenceItemDefaultNew | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.4 | Requires sequence item constructor new() to provide a default value for the string name argument to support UVM factory creation and cloning. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-009`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-009) | SequenceBodyWithoutStartItem | ERROR | methodology |  | Flags calls to finish_item() inside uvm_sequence::body() that are not preceded by a corresponding start_item(). The UVM sequencer arbitration handshake strictly requires start_item() before finish_item(). |
| [`UVM-SEQ-010`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-010) | SequenceItemCreateWithoutType | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.5 | Flags sequence items created via direct new() inside sequence body(). Sequence items must be created via factory type_id::create() to allow testcase overrides. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-011`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-011) | UncheckedPSequencerCast | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.1 | Flags unchecked $cast(p_sequencer, m_sequencer) calls in sequences that do not verify the return status. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-012`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-012) | SequenceStartOnNullSequencer | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags sequence start(null) calls that start sequences without an attached sequencer handle. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-013`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-013) | SequenceItemTypeCompatibility | WARNING | methodology |  | Statically verifies that transaction item types between uvm_driver#(REQ) and uvm_sequencer#(REQ) are type-compatible across connect_phase connections. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-014`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-014) | UnusedSequence | WARNING | methodology |  | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags a sequence that no other class in the compilation names, when the run also contains a test. Experimental: the sequence may be started from a file that was not linted. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-015`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-015) | UnusedSequenceItem | WARNING | methodology |  | **Experimental** (runs with `--experimental`). Flags a sequence item that no other class in the compilation names, when the run also contains a test. Experimental: the item may be created from a file that was not linted. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-016`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-016) | SequencerFromConfigDb | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags uvm_config_db/uvm_resource_db get() calls in a sequence that fetch a sequencer handle. Bind sub-sequencers once, in a virtual sequencer or the test. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-017`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-017) | PSequencerTypeMismatch | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags sequence .start(seqr) calls where the target sequencer's static class type is incompatible with the p_sequencer type declared by the sequence. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-018`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-018) | StartingPhaseWithoutNullGuard | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags dereferencing starting_phase inside a uvm_sequence without an enclosing 'if (starting_phase != null)' guard. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-019`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-SEQ-019) | VirtualSequencerWiringChecker | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Statically verifies that sub-sequencer handles declared within a virtual sequencer are fully wired and assigned in connect_phase across the verification environment. |
| [`UVM-SEQ-020`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-SEQ-020) | IncompleteItemContract | WARNING | methodology | MG-4.4 | Flags concrete sequence items with fields that implement neither field macros nor do_copy(), do_compare() and convert2string()/do_print(). Scoreboards, clone() and debug prints then silently see default behaviour (MG-4.4). |
| [`UVM-SEQ-021`](../../testdata/rules/antipattern/UVM-SEQ-021) | DirectDoMethodCall | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags direct calls to do_copy, do_compare, do_print, do_pack, do_unpack and do_record. These are hooks for the public copy/compare/print/pack/record methods; calling them directly bypasses the policy object. super.do_*() inside an override is allowed. |
| [`UVM-TLM-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-001) | UvmUnconnectedTlmPort | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Mandatory TLM ports and exports declared in uvm_component must be connected in connect_phase to prevent runtime fatal errors or null-pointer dereferences. |
| [`UVM-TLM-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-002) | UvmTlmTryGetUnchecked | WARNING | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags calls to non-blocking TLM methods (try_get(), try_peek(), try_put()) where the boolean return status is ignored. |
| [`UVM-TLM-003`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-003) | TlmTopologyChecker | WARNING | methodology | MG-5.1 | Performs cross-component elaboration topology checks to verify that mandatory TLM ports (such as driver seq_item_pull_port and monitor analysis_port) are bound in connect_phase across the verification environment hierarchy. |
| [`UVM-TLM-004`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-004) | AnalysisTransactionMutation | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Detects in-place modification of transactions received via analysis write() methods. Because analysis ports broadcast by reference, modifying transaction fields directly causes silent data corruption across other concurrent subscribers and scoreboards. |
| [`UVM-TLM-005`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-005) | AnalysisFifoDrainStarvation | WARNING | methodology |  | Detects instantiated uvm_tlm_analysis_fifo components that receive transactions via connect_phase but have zero drain operations (.get(), .try_get()) across all task-based phases, causing unbounded simulation heap memory growth and fatal bad_alloc crashes. |
| `UVM-TLM-006` | UncoveredAnalysisPort | WARNING | methodology |  | A transaction type a monitor publishes on an analysis port that no coverage collector receives: no class with a covergroup (its own, a base class's or a held object's) extends `uvm_subscriber #(T)` or holds an analysis imp, export, FIFO or get/peek port of `T`. Only reported when the testbench declares covergroups at all; one finding per type, naming every port. On the corpus it finds core-v-verif's agents, whose coverage models receive the monitor transactions but have only TODO covergroups. |
| [`UVM-TLM-007`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-007) | UvmTransactionAliasing | WARNING | methodology | MG-3.1 | Disallows in-place mutation of transaction objects after broadcasting via an analysis port (.write()). Analysis ports pass shared references; subsequent in-place mutations corrupt downstream scoreboards and subscribers. |
| [`UVM-TLM-008`](../../testdata/rules/oop/UVM-TLM-008) | ObserverStateMutationInWrite | ERROR | methodology | MG-3.1 | Mutating the observed transaction object inside a subscriber's write() method corrupts state for other concurrent subscribers in the Observer pattern. Clone the transaction before mutating. |
| [`UVM-TLM-009`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-009) | BlockingInObserver | ERROR | methodology | MG-5.1 | Analysis write() implementations (uvm_subscriber::write and the write<SFX> methods behind uvm_analysis_imp<SFX>) must be functions that finish in zero time. Flags a write declared as a task, and a write that forks a thread per transaction. |
| [`UVM-TLM-010`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-010) | ScoreboardSilentDrop | ERROR | methodology | MG-8.1 | Detects silent returns in scoreboard write methods when expected queues are empty without logging an error. Spurious or unpredicted DUT packets are dropped, hiding hardware bugs. |
| [`UVM-TLM-011`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-TLM-011) | ScoreboardLeftoverQueue | ERROR | methodology | MG-8.1 | Scoreboard expected transaction queues must be checked for drain completeness in check_phase or report_phase. Missing drain checks allow dropped DUT packets to pass silently. |
| [`UVM-TLM-012`](../../testdata/rules/errors/UVM-TLM-012) | CheckerCannotFail | ERROR | methodology | MG-8.1 | Flags scoreboard and checker classes with no way to report a failure: no `uvm_error or `uvm_fatal, no assertion and no comparator, in the class, its bases or the helpers it calls (Sonar S2699, tests without assertions). |

## Performance

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-PRF-001`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-001) | PassArrayByValue | WARNING | performance |  | Passing dynamic arrays, queues, associative arrays, unpacked arrays, or unpacked structs by value (input) causes expensive memory duplication on every call. Use 'const ref' or 'ref' instead. |
| [`SVL-PRF-002`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-002) | ArrayReductionWidthTruncation | ERROR | performance |  | Array reduction methods (.sum, .product) accumulate at element bit-width before extension to LHS. Summing sub-32-bit elements into 32/64-bit integers causes silent wraparound unless cast in with(). |
| [`SVL-PRF-003`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-003) | DynArrayIncrementalResizeInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Growing dynamic arrays incrementally inside loops with `new[arr.size()+1](arr)` causes O(N^2) memory reallocation bottlenecks. Pre-allocate with new[N] or use SystemVerilog queues instead. |
| [`SVL-PRF-004`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-004) | ProceduralZeroDelay | WARNING | performance |  | Procedural delay #0 reschedules execution into the Inactive region. Repeated #0 rescheduling causes delta-cycle thrashing and degrades simulation throughput. |
| [`SVL-PRF-005`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-005) | UnshieldedVerbosityFormatEval | WARNING | performance |  | Calling $sformatf inside uvm_info/warning without checking uvm_report_enabled formats strings even when messages are discarded by verbosity. |
| [`SVL-PRF-006`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-006) | StringKeyAssociativeArray | WARNING | advisory |  | Detects associative arrays indexed by 'string'. String keys incur hash calculation and dynamic string comparisons on every lookup and insert, degrading simulation throughput in hot paths. |
| [`SVL-PRF-007`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-007) | QueueConcatAppend | WARNING | performance |  | Disallow queue concatenation ('q = {q, x}' or 'q = {x, q}'). Concatenation reallocates memory on every append ($O(N^2)$ in loops); use push_back() or push_front() for amortized $O(1)$ performance. |
| [`SVL-PRF-008`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-008) | QueueSlicePopFirst | WARNING | performance |  | Disallow queue slicing ('q = q[1:$]') to drop head elements. Queue slicing duplicates all remaining elements into new memory; use pop_front() for in-place $O(1)$ head-pointer advance. |
| [`SVL-PRF-009`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-009) | NbaOnClassProperty | WARNING | performance |  | Disallow non-blocking assignments ('<=') on class properties. For heap-allocated class instances, NBAs force the simulator kernel to create dynamic event descriptors in the NBA region of the event wheel. Use blocking assignment ('='). |
| [`SVL-PRF-010`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-010) | StringConcatInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Disallows iterative in-place string concatenation or $sformatf recursion inside loop bodies to prevent O(N^2) memory reallocation overhead. |
| [`SVL-PRF-011`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-011) | DynamicArrayNewInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Disallows dynamic array allocation (new[...]) inside simulation loops to prevent heap contention and memory churn. |
| [`SVL-PRF-012`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-012) | UnboundedDynamicArrayInConstraint | WARNING | performance |  | Flags dynamic array or queue size constraints with an upper bound (< or <=) lacking an explicit lower bound. |
| [`SVL-PRF-013`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-013) | ForkInClockedLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Flags fork/join, join_any, and join_none inside a clocked loop (always_ff, always @(posedge/negedge), or a loop that waits on a clock edge). A thread started on every clock piles work onto the scheduler. |
| [`SVL-PRF-014`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-PRF-014) | AssociativeArrayMutatingRead | INFO | advisory |  | Flags unguarded associative-array read lookups in relational comparisons without an exists() check (IEEE 1800 § 7.8.6). |
| [`SVL-PRF-015`](../../testdata/rules/correctness/SVL-PRF-015) | ArrayLocatorEmptyQueueDeref | ERROR | performance |  | Disallows immediate element dereferencing on array locator methods (e.g., q.find()[0]). Locator methods return an unpacked queue that may be empty, causing out-of-bounds runtime errors (IEEE 1800 § 7.12.1). |
| [`SVL-PRF-016`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SVL-PRF-016) | ClassInstantiationInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Disallows direct class instantiation via new() inside simulation loops to prevent heap contention and memory allocation overhead. |

## DeadCode

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-DED-001`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-001) | UnusedVariable | INFO | soundness | MG-9.1 | Local variables declared in tasks or functions should be referenced. Unused variables clutter code, consume memory, and often indicate incomplete logic. |
| [`SVL-DED-002`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-002) | UnreachableStatementsPostReturn | WARNING | soundness |  | Detects unreachable statements appearing after an unconditional control-flow termination (return, break, continue). Dead code clutters verification environments and hides logic errors. |
| [`SVL-DED-003`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-003) | AccidentalEmptyConditional | ERROR | soundness |  | Detects accidental semicolons immediately following if() or while() headers. An empty conditional branch causes subsequent blocks to execute unconditionally, introducing severe logic bugs. |
| [`SVL-DED-004`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-004) | ConsecutiveDeadStore | WARNING | soundness |  | Detects consecutive assignments to the same variable where the initial value is immediately overwritten without being read. Dead stores waste CPU cycles and frequently reveal copy-paste logic bugs. |
| [`SVL-DED-005`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-005) | UnreadClassProperty | INFO | soundness | MG-9.1 | Flags class properties that are assigned or written to, but never read anywhere in the class. Unread properties indicate dead instrumentation or abandoned design state. |
| [`SVL-DED-006`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-006) | UnwrittenClassProperty | WARNING | soundness | MG-9.1 | Flags non-rand class properties that lack an initializer, are read in methods, but never written or assigned. Unwritten properties always evaluate to uninitialized defaults, risking dead branches and silent logic bugs. |
| [`SVL-DED-007`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-007) | UnusedPureRoutineResult | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags calls to pure functions or value-returning routines ($sformatf, $realtime, len, toupper, sum) used as standalone statements where the result is discarded. |
| [`SVL-DED-008`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-008) | UnusedGenerateBlock | INFO | soundness |  | Flags conditional statements or generate blocks with constant false conditions ('0') and no 'else' clause. |
| [`SVL-DED-009`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-009) | EmptyAlwaysOrInitial | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows initial, always, always_comb, always_ff, always_latch, or final procedural blocks with empty bodies. |
| [`SVL-DED-010`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-010) | EmptyForkJoin | WARNING | soundness |  | Disallows empty fork...join, fork...join_any, or fork...join_none blocks that contain zero statements. |
| [`SVL-DED-011`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-011) | EmptyTaskOrFunction | WARNING | soundness | MG-9.1 | Flags concrete, non-virtual, non-extern tasks and functions with empty bodies (zero statements). Empty routines cause useless call overhead and indicate incomplete or dead logic. |
| [`SVL-DED-012`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-012) | UnreferencedParameter | WARNING | soundness | MG-9.1 | Flags parameter and localparam declarations that are never referenced within their scope or testbench. Unused parameters create clutter and indicate dead or abandoned configurations. |
| [`SVL-DED-013`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-013) | UnusedRoutineArgument | INFO | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags task and function arguments that the body never uses (clang-tidy misc-unused-parameters, Pylint W0613). Virtual methods and overrides, phase methods, DPI routines and empty bodies are skipped. |
| [`SVL-DED-014`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-014) | UnusedLocalMethod | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags a local task or function that no method of its class calls. A local method is invisible outside the class, so with no caller it is dead. |
| [`SVL-DED-015`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-015) | NeverSetClassParameter | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a parameter of a user parameterized class that no specialization in the linted design ever sets. The class claims a flexibility nobody uses or verifies (Fowler 'speculative generality'); make it a localparam or drop it. Whole-program: a specialization in a file that was not linted is not seen, and only specializations used as a class member or base class are counted. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-DED-016`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-016) | UnreferencedTypedef | INFO | smells |  | Flags typedef declarations inside modules, interfaces, classes, and subroutines whose type alias is never referenced anywhere in scope. |
| [`SVL-DED-017`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SVL-DED-017) | UnreferencedMacro | INFO | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags file-local `define macros in .sv implementation files that are never expanded or queried in conditional compilation. |

## Maintainability

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-MNT-001`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-001) | RefArgumentNeverWritten | INFO | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags ref arguments that the routine only reads; declare them const ref so callers know they are not modified (clang-tidy readability-non-const-parameter). Virtual methods are skipped because overrides share the signature. |
| [`SVL-MNT-002`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-002) | DefineForConstant | WARNING | smells | MG-6.1 | Flags `define macros whose body is only a number or a string, used as constants. A package parameter or localparam has a type and a scope; a macro is global to the rest of the compilation and can be redefined silently (MG-6.1). |
| [`SVL-MNT-003`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-003) | MacroAsRoutine | INFO | advisory | MG-6.1 | Flags multi-statement code macros that use nothing only a macro can do: no token pasting, stringification, nested macros, `__FILE__, type arguments, declarations or return/break. A function or task would be type-checked and debuggable (MG-6.1). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-004`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-004) | IfdefInReusableClass | WARNING | smells | MG-6.1 | Flags `ifdef, `ifndef and `elsif inside class bodies, apart from simulator and UVM version shims. Compile-time switches multiply the variants of a class and cannot be chosen per instance; configuration can (MG-6.1). |
| [`SVL-MNT-005`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-005) | StringAsEnum | WARNING | smells | MG-6.2 | Flags a string variable compared against three or more literals in one case statement or if/else-if chain. The values form an enumeration the compiler cannot check; a typo in any of them fails silently (Fowler 'primitive obsession', MG-6.2). String arguments are SVL-MNT-008's. |
| [`SVL-MNT-006`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-006) | ManualBitFieldSlicing | INFO | advisory | MG-6.2 | Flags a vector that is cut into three or more different fixed part-selects (hdr[7:0], hdr[15:8], hdr[31:16]). The field layout lives in scattered numbers; a packed struct names it once (MG-6.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-007`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-007) | FunctionOutputArguments | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags void class functions that hand their results back through output arguments. A return value, or a struct for several values, keeps the call an expression and makes the data flow visible (command-query separation, MG-6.3). Overrides are left alone, since their signature is fixed. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-008) | StringModeParameter | WARNING | smells | MG-2.4 | Flags routines whose string argument is compared against two or more literals to choose what to do, as in do_op("read"). Caller and callee must agree on spellings the compiler never checks (control coupling, connascence of meaning, MG-2.4). Use an enum argument or separate routines. Overrides are left alone. |
| [`SVL-MNT-009`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-009) | GodClass | WARNING | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes that are very complex (WMC >= 47), use many other classes' data (ATFD > 5) and have low cohesion (TCC < 1/3): PMD's GodClass detection strategy. |
| [`SVL-MNT-010`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-010) | LowCohesion | INFO | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes whose methods split into two or more groups that share no fields and do not call each other (LCOM4 > 1): the class is really several classes. |
| [`SVL-MNT-011`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-011) | HighCoupling | INFO | smells | MG-2.1 | Flags classes other than envs and tests that reference more than 10 distinct user class types (CK coupling between objects, PMD CouplingBetweenObjects). |
| [`SVL-MNT-012`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-012) | DeepInheritance | INFO | smells |  | Flags classes with more than 3 user-defined ancestors above the UVM base class (CK depth of inheritance tree, Pylint too-many-ancestors). |
| [`SVL-MNT-013`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-013) | OverrideOnlyCallsSuper | INFO | smells | MG-5.2 | Flags overrides whose whole body is the super call with the same arguments, such as a connect_phase that only calls super.connect_phase(phase) (Pylint useless-parent-delegation, Sonar S1185). Constructors are kept. |
| [`SVL-MNT-014`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-014) | EmptyOverrideOfConcrete | WARNING | smells | MG-5.2 | Flags an empty override of a user base-class method that has a body, which silently switches the inherited behavior off (Fowler 'refused bequest', Liskov substitution). |
| [`SVL-MNT-015`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-015) | MutablePackageState | WARNING | methodology | MG-2.3 | Flags non-const variables declared in packages. They are shared by every env instance and test in a run (clang-tidy cppcoreguidelines-avoid-non-const-global-variables). |
| [`SVL-MNT-016`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-016) | RepeatedEnumSwitch | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags an enum that is switched on with case in three or more classes, a sign that behavior per kind belongs in a polymorphic item or policy class (Fowler 'repeated switches'). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-017`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-017) | QueryChangesState | INFO | advisory |  | Flags functions named get_*, is_* or has_* that write class properties (command-query separation). get_next_* is allowed. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-018`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-018) | FeatureEnvy | INFO | advisory | MG-3.1 | Flags a method that uses one other object's fields at least 6 times (option min_foreign) and more than twice as often as its own class's fields. The logic belongs with the data it uses (Fowler: Feature Envy; MG-3.1). Transactions, config objects, the same class and classes in the same hierarchy do not count, nor do copy/compare/print and build/connect methods. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-019`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-019) | PrimitiveObsession | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a rand integral field of a sequence item or config that a constraint limits to a list of 3 to 16 single constant values ('x inside {0, 1, 2}'). The field is an enumeration: as an enum it prints by name in logs and waveforms and the compiler checks every value. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-020`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-020) | FatalStubOverride | WARNING | smells |  | Flags an override of a user base-class method whose whole body is an error or fatal report ("not supported here"). The subclass refuses part of its parent's contract, so code holding a base handle fails at run time (Fowler 'refused bequest'). Split the base class instead. SVL-MNT-014 covers empty overrides. |
| [`SVL-MNT-021`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-MNT-021) | DuplicateMethodBody | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Detects identical or copy-pasted subroutine method bodies across different classes. Duplicated code should be refactored into shared base classes or utilities. |
| [`SVL-MNT-022`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-022) | CloneFragments | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Finds runs of three or more statements (at least 50 tokens) that appear in more than one place, also when variables and literals were renamed consistently. Macro calls count as written, not as their expansion, and called names must match; runs that repeat one short cycle of statements, like unrolled loops, are left out. Each pair of routines is reported once; whole identical method bodies are SVL-MNT-021's, and files whose header says they are generated are left out (DRY, Type-1/2 clones, MG-7.1). |
| [`SVL-MNT-023`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-023) | DuplicatedConstraint | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Flags a constraint body repeated in two classes that do not inherit from each other. The rule then lives in two places and drifts; declare it once in a shared base class or a policy object (Fowler 'pull up', MG-7.1). SVL-RND-010 covers repeats inside one class. |
| [`SVL-MNT-024`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-024) | RepeatedStringLiteral | INFO | advisory | MG-7.1 | Flags a string literal, such as a report ID or a file name, written four or more times in the code. Config keys (UVM-CFG-008), instance names and class names are left out. One named constant keeps the copies in step (DRY, MG-7.1). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-025`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-025) | CopiedAgentPackage | INFO | advisory | MG-7.2 | Flags two packages whose classes have the same roles, fields and method bodies apart from renamed identifiers, for at least three classes and 80% of the classes in the larger package (classes with almost no code are not counted). They are one agent copied and renamed; a parameterized agent, or a shared base with small subclasses, keeps one copy to fix (DRY, MG-7.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-026`](../../testdata/rules/design/SVL-MNT-026) | DataClumps | INFO | advisory |  | Flags the same group of min_args (default 4) or more arguments (same names and types) declared by min_routines (default 3) or more routines. Values that always travel together belong in a transaction or struct; passing them one by one lets two same-typed arguments be swapped silently (Fowler 'data clumps'). Overrides are counted once, at the base declaration; each group is reported once, at its first routine. Advisory: off by default. |
| `SVL-MNT-027` | Hotspot | INFO | advisory | MG-9.2 | With --history: reports the files that are both complex (summed cyclomatic complexity of their routines) and often changed in git, the top five by complexity times commits. Such hotspots are where defects collect and where refactoring pays first (Tornhill, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| `SVL-MNT-028` | ChangeCoupling | INFO | advisory | MG-9.2 | With --history: reports two files in different packages that change together in at least three commits and in at least half of the commits touching either. The packages have a hidden dependency that their imports do not show; move the shared knowledge to one place (temporal coupling, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-029`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-029) | CognitiveComplexity | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines whose Sonar cognitive complexity (nesting-weighted branching, with fork/join counted as nesting) exceeds the threshold (default 25; Sonar S3776). |
| [`SVL-MNT-030`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-030) | LongRoutine | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines with more statements than the threshold (default 100; clang-tidy readability-function-size, Checkstyle MethodLength). |
| [`SVL-MNT-031`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-031) | TooManyArguments | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags tasks and functions with more formal arguments than the threshold (default 7; Pylint R0913, Sonar S107). Overrides are judged at the base declaration only. |
| [`SVL-MNT-032`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-032) | DeepNesting | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines whose control structures nest deeper than the threshold (default 5; Checkstyle NestedIfDepth, clang-tidy readability-function-size NestingThreshold). |
| [`SVL-MNT-033`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-033) | ComplexCondition | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags conditions with more && / \|\| operators than the threshold (default 5; Pylint R0916, Checkstyle BooleanExpressionComplexity). |
| [`SVL-MNT-034`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-034) | LargeClass | INFO | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes with more than 30 properties or 30 methods; config objects and sequence items may have 80 properties, register models are exempt (PMD TooManyFields and TooManyMethods, Pylint R0902/R0904). |
| [`SVL-MNT-035`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-035) | LongTask | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags tasks longer than the line budget (default 40 source lines, option max_lines). A long task is hard to review and to cover; split it into named tasks with one job each. |
| [`SVL-MNT-036`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-036) | RandFieldBudget | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags a sequence item that declares more than the rand-field budget (default 8, option max_rand), counting rand and randc properties of the class itself. A wide item is slow to solve and hard to constrain; split the fields across items. |
| [`SVL-MNT-037`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SVL-MNT-037) | ConfigKnobBudget | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags a configuration object (a uvm_object named *cfg* or *config*) that declares more than max_knobs (default 12) data members of its own. Split it into per-agent or per-feature sub-configs that the parent config holds. Advisory: SVL-MNT-034 already allows config objects up to 80 fields, so this stricter budget is opt-in. |
| [`SVL-MNT-038`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-038) | WildcardImportOutsidePackage | WARNING | methodology | MG-1.3 | Flags 'import pkg::*' at file ($unit) scope, and inside files that are `include'd into a package. Both leak names into code that never asked for them and hide where a dependency comes from (information hiding, MG-1.3). |
| [`SVL-MNT-039`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-039) | UnusedPackageImport | WARNING | methodology | MG-1.3 | Flags package imports that supply no name used in their scope. An unused import is a false dependency: the package is compiled first, changes to it look relevant, and names it exports can collide with local ones (common reuse principle, MG-1.3). |
| [`SVL-MNT-040`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-040) | PackageLayerInversion | WARNING | methodology | MG-1.1 | Flags a package that imports a package from a higher testbench layer, such as an agent package importing an env or test package. The lower package can then not be compiled or reused without the higher one (acyclic and stable dependencies, MG-1.1). UVM-CMP-001 checks the same order between classes. |
| [`SVL-MNT-041`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-MNT-041) | UnstablePackageDependedOn | INFO | advisory | MG-1.4 | Computes instability I = Ce / (Ca + Ce) for each user package from its imports and flags a package that depends on a less stable one. Many packages rely on a stable package, so its own dependencies should be at least as stable (Martin's stable dependencies principle, MG-1.4). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-042`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-042) | PositionalFlagLiterals | INFO | smells | MG-2.4 | Flags calls that pass two or more 0/1 literals positionally to 1-bit arguments; use named argument binding (clang-tidy bugprone-argument-comment, Clean Code flag arguments). |
| [`SVL-MNT-043`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-043) | MagicNumber | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags numeric literals other than 0, 1 and -1 in class method bodies: conditions, loop bounds and sizes; delays are left to the magic-delay rules (Checkstyle MagicNumber, Sonar S109). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-044`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-044) | CommentedOutCode | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags blocks of // comments that parse as SystemVerilog statements or declarations (Sonar S125). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-045`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-045) | UndocumentedExtensionPoint | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags new virtual methods without a preceding comment in classes meant to be extended: classes with user subclasses, classes named *base*, and callbacks (Checkstyle MissingJavadocMethod, Pylint C0116). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-046`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-046) | RedundantBoolean | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags 1-bit values compared with 1'b1/1'b0 and 'if (c) return 1; else return 0;' (Sonar S1125, clang-tidy readability-simplify-boolean-expr). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-047`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-047) | DoubleNegativeFlag | INFO | advisory |  | Flags '!' (or '~' on one bit) applied to a variable whose name is negative (disable_*, no_*, not_*, skip_*, inhibit_*, ...). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-048`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-048) | NonDescriptiveName | INFO | advisory |  | Flags class properties, and locals of routines longer than min_lines (default 10), named tmp, temp, val, obj, foo, d, t and the like (with or without a number; locals also data and value). Arguments and loop variables are not checked. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-049`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-049) | UnclearAbbreviation | INFO | advisory |  | Flags class, property, method and local names containing a vowel-less word of four or more letters (trnsfr, chnnl, rgstr) that is not a common DV short form (clk, cfg, ctrl, jtag, ...). Each person drops different vowels, so such names defeat grep. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-050`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-050) | RedundantComment | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a one-line // comment directly above a statement when every word of the comment (2 to 6 words, ignoring a, the, to, ...) is already a word of the statement's names, e.g. '// set cfg' above set_cfg(). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-051`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SVL-MNT-051) | UndocumentedTestbenchClass | INFO | advisory |  | Flags UVM components and sequences without a comment of at least min_words (default 10) words of prose right above the class. Copyright and license lines do not count. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SVL-MNT-052`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SVL-MNT-052) | ScratchpadClassProperty | WARNING | smells |  | Disallow declaring scratchpad variables or loop induction counters as class properties. Move declarations to method stack frames to ensure thread safety and re-entrancy. |
| [`SVL-MNT-053`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SVL-MNT-053) | MagicDelayInSequence | WARNING | smells |  | Disallow hardcoded physical delays (#delay) inside uvm_sequence. Sequences must be clocking-block and frequency agnostic. |
| [`SVL-MNT-054`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SVL-MNT-054) | GenericReportId | INFO | smells |  | Disallow generic single-word report IDs ('ERR', 'INFO', 'DEBUG') in UVM reporting macros. Use feature-scoped hierarchical identifiers to support precise log filtering. |
| [`SVL-MNT-055`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SVL-MNT-055) | CyclomaticComplexityGodMethod | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Detects subroutines with high McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity ($M > 15$). Complex control flow obscures edge cases and inhibits functional verification. |
| [`SVL-MNT-056`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-MNT-056) | DuplicateMacroRedefinition | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags redefining an already-defined macro in the same file with a different replacement body without an intervening `undef or mutually exclusive conditional branch. |
| [`SVL-WVR-001`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-WVR-001) | UnclosedBlockWaiver | WARNING | soundness |  | Flags scoped block waiver comments (svlang-lint:off, verissimo_lint: waive_start) that are never closed with a matching on/waive_stop directive before the end of the file. |
| `SVL-WVR-002` | UnusedWaiver | ERROR | soundness |  | Reports inline or configuration waivers whose message regex fails to compile, or waivers that match no diagnostic under --report-unused-waivers / --strict-waivers. (reported by `SVL-WVR-001`) |

## Portability

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `SVL-DPI-001` | ConflictingDpiPrototypes | ERROR | soundness |  | One C function imported with two different prototypes. |
| [`SVL-DPI-002`](../../testdata/rules/dpi/SVL-DPI-002) | DpiTypeWidthAlignment | WARNING | soundness, security |  | Disallow 4-state types (integer, reg) in DPI-C declarations. 4-state types require complex svLogicVecVal structs in C; use 2-state portable types (int, longint, byte) for C99 ABI compatibility. |
| [`SVL-PRT-001`](../../testdata/rules/portability/SVL-PRT-001) | ProprietaryVendorCalls | WARNING | soundness, security | MG-4.3 | Disallow unguarded simulator-proprietary system tasks ($vcdpluson, $fsdbDumpvars, $shm_open). Vendor-specific calls prevent Verification IP from running on other simulators. |
| [`SVL-PRT-002`](../../testdata/rules/portability/SVL-PRT-002) | HardcodedHostPaths | ERROR | soundness, security | MG-4.3 | Disallow hardcoded absolute filesystem paths (/home/..., C:\...) in file operations ($readmemh, $fopen). Absolute paths break regression execution in containerized CI/CD pipelines. |
| [`SVL-PRT-003`](../../testdata/rules/portability/SVL-PRT-003) | GlobalUnitPollution | ERROR | soundness | MG-1.3 | Disallow variables, nets, typedefs, tasks, and functions declared directly in the $unit compilation unit scope. Declarations outside a package or module cause cross-file namespace pollution and compile-order dependencies in multi-unit compilation. |
| `SVL-PRT-004` | HeaderMacroLeak | WARNING | methodology, style | MG-1.3 | Macros defined inside header files (.svh) must be undef'd with `undef before the end of the file unless registered as public API macros. Leaking macros causes silent parameter overrides and compilation collisions. |
| [`UVM-PRT-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PRT-001) | AccelleraOnlyApi | INFO | soundness, security |  | Flags calls to, and classes extending, parts of the Accellera UVM library that IEEE 1800.2 does not define (tagged @uvm-accellera in the library source), such as uvm_component::print_config or uvm_port_base::debug_connected_to. Code that relies on them is tied to one UVM implementation and release. The list comes from the UVM API pack of the version being compiled. |
| [`UVM-PRT-002`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-PRT-002) | ContribOnlyApi | INFO | soundness, security |  | Flags calls to, and classes extending, experimental contributed UVM APIs tagged @uvm-contrib in the compiled UVM library that IEEE 1800.2 does not standardize. |

## Security

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-SEC-001`](../../testdata/rules/security/SVL-SEC-001) | PlaintextKeyInLogs | WARNING | security |  | Detects plaintext logging of sensitive cryptographic assets (keys, secrets, passwords) via $sformatf/$display. Logging secrets compromises hardware security and violates ISO/SAE 21434 regression standards. |
| [`SVL-SEC-002`](../../testdata/rules/security/SVL-SEC-002) | UncheckedFopen | WARNING | soundness, security | MG-8.1 | Flags unchecked $fopen return descriptors and discarded $fopen calls. File operations must check whether the descriptor is valid before performing file I/O. |

## Deprecated

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-DEP-001`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-001) | ProgramBlockDeprecation | ERROR | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow the obsolete SystemVerilog 'program' block. Modern verification architectures mandate 'module' with clocking blocks to prevent premature simulation termination. |
| [`SVL-DEP-002`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-002) | DefparamDeprecation | ERROR | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow 'defparam' statements. Parameter overrides must be specified directly on instance headers. |
| [`SVL-DEP-003`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-003) | LegacyAlwaysBlock | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.3 | Flags RTL sensitivity-list 'always @(...)' blocks that should use IEEE 1800 always_comb, always_ff, or always_latch (exempting testbench #delay clock generators and multi-wait processes). |
| [`SVL-DEP-004`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-004) | RandomSystemFunction | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow legacy Verilog '$random'. Replaced by '$urandom' and '$urandom_range' in IEEE 1800. |
| [`SVL-DEP-005`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-005) | ProceduralContinuousAssign | ERROR | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow procedural 'assign' and 'deassign' statements. Procedural continuous assignments are non-synthesizable and induce simulation race conditions. |
| [`SVL-DEP-006`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/SVL-DEP-006) | NonAnsiPortList | INFO | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow obsolete non-ANSI port list declarations. Enforces modern ANSI-style inline port lists. |
| [`SVL-DEP-007`](../../testdata/rules/antipattern/SVL-DEP-007) | LegacyRegWireInTestbench | INFO | methodology, style | MG-6.3 | Discourages legacy Verilog-1995 'reg' variable declarations in favor of IEEE 1800 'logic' (leaving 'wire' nets intact). |
| [`UVM-DEP-001`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/UVM-DEP-001) | UvmDeprecatedConfigCalls | ERROR | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow deprecated legacy set_config_* and get_config_* methods (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Use type-safe uvm_config_db#(T)::set/get. |
| [`UVM-DEP-002`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/UVM-DEP-002) | UvmDeprecatedReportServer | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow direct singleton calls to uvm_report_server::get_server() (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Obtain report servers through uvm_coreservice_t. |
| [`UVM-DEP-003`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/UVM-DEP-003) | UvmDeprecatedPrinterKnobs | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow direct access to 'printer.knobs' (IEEE 1800.2 § 5.5.2). Use accessor methods on uvm_printer. |
| [`UVM-DEP-004`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/UVM-DEP-004) | UvmDeprecatedTestDone | ERROR | methodology | MG-6.3 | Disallow obsolete OVM 'uvm_test_done' objection handle (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Attach objections to the active phase parameter. |
| [`UVM-DEP-005`](../../testdata/rules/deprecated/UVM-DEP-005) | DeprecatedStartingPhase | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags direct reads and writes of the deprecated 'starting_phase' field in UVM sequences (IEEE 1800.2-2020 §14.2.2) in favor of get_starting_phase() and set_starting_phase(). |
| [`UVM-DEP-006`](../../testdata/rules/antipattern/UVM-DEP-006) | UvmBannedFieldMacros | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.1 | Bans the `uvm_field_* macro suite. Mandates manual do_copy, do_compare, and do_print methods to eliminate severe simulation performance overhead and uncontrollable deep copy bugs. |
| [`UVM-DEP-007`](../../testdata/rules/antipattern/UVM-DEP-007) | UvmBannedUvmDoMacros | WARNING | methodology | MG-6.1 | Discourages black-box `uvm_do macros in sequence bodies. Mandates explicit start_item / finish_item transaction handshakes. |
| [`UVM-DEP-008`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-DEP-008) | DeprecatedUvmMacro | WARNING | methodology |  | Flags uses of UVM macros that the UVM version being compiled defines only under UVM_ENABLE_DEPRECATED_API (in UVM 2020: `uvm_do_with, `uvm_do_on, `uvm_do_pri, `uvm_create_on, `uvm_send_pri and the rest of that family). Without the define the code does not compile. The list comes from the UVM API pack of the version being compiled. |
| `UVM-DEP-009` | DeprecatedUvmApi | WARNING | methodology |  | Calls to UVM methods, and classes extending UVM classes, that the compiled UVM release keeps only as deprecated API (UVM 1.1d/1.2: what `UVM_NO_DEPRECATED` removes, such as `uvm_component::set_config_int` or `uvm_random_sequence`). Read from the release's API pack in `data/uvm-api/`. |

## Style

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-STY-001`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-001) | MacroTrailingSemicolon | WARNING | style |  | Flags unnecessary semicolons following `uvm_* macro invocations that create empty statements in declarative or procedural scopes. |
| [`SVL-STY-002`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-002) | TodoCommentTracker | INFO | style |  | Tracks unresolved TODO, FIXME, ICEBOX, HACK, and XXX comment markers across the codebase. Ensures temporary developer placeholders are addressed before tape-out or milestone delivery. |
| `SVL-STY-003` | MandatoryMatchingEndLabel | INFO | style |  | Enforces explicit and matching end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., endfunction : name). Prevents scope delimiter ambiguity in large verification codebases. |
| [`SVL-STY-004`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-004) | MismatchedEndLabel | WARNING | style |  | Flags mismatched end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., function void foo(); ... endfunction : bar). Prevents scope delimiter confusion and copy-paste errors. |
| [`SVL-STY-005`](../../testdata/rules/documentation/SVL-STY-005) | MethodBannerStyle | INFO | style |  | Standardizes method separator pre-banners. Enforces 70–80 character uniform dashed separator lines and flags ragged or arbitrary-width comment separators. |
| [`SVL-STY-006`](../../testdata/rules/documentation/SVL-STY-006) | SectionHeaderBanner | INFO | style |  | Standardizes major section divider banners to uniform 70–80 character widths. Prevents ragged ASCII banners across verification packages and testbench files. |
| [`SVL-STY-007`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SVL-STY-007) | ExternMethodThreshold | WARNING | style | MG-9.1 | Enforces 'extern' declaration for class methods exceeding N lines of code (default: 5 lines). Keeps class declarations concise and readable as clean interface definitions. |
| [`SVL-STY-008`](../../testdata/rules/safety/SVL-STY-008) | ExplicitLiteralWidth | WARNING | style |  | Disallow unsized integer and numeric literals without explicit bit-width declarations. Prevents silent 32-bit zero-extension and sign extension bugs. |
| [`SVL-STY-009`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-009) | OneStatementPerLine | WARNING | style |  | Prohibit multiple procedural statements on the same line separated by semicolons. Enforces clean formatting and deterministic single-stepping in simulation debuggers. |
| [`SVL-STY-010`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-010) | SpaceKeywordParen | INFO | style |  | Requires a single space between control keywords (if, for, foreach, while, case) and opening parenthesis. Enforces common SystemVerilog code formatting guidelines. |
| `SVL-STY-011` | IncludeGuard | ERROR | style | MG-1.3 | Every included header file (.svh) must be wrapped in standard macro include guards (`ifndef / `define / `endif) to prevent circular definitions and compiler redefinition errors. |
| [`SVL-STY-012`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-012) | TrailingWhitespace | INFO | style |  | Disallows trailing whitespace (spaces and tabs) at the end of lines in source files. |
| [`SVL-STY-013`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-013) | MaxLineLength | INFO | style |  | Flags source lines exceeding 120 characters (option: max_columns) to preserve readability across split-view editors and terminal reviews. |
| [`SVL-STY-014`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-014) | InconsistentBlockIndentation | INFO | style |  | Flags multi-line begin/end, class, module, function, and task blocks whose direct child items have unindented or inconsistent column alignment. |
| [`SVL-STY-015`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-015) | MultipleDeclarationsPerLine | INFO | style |  | Flags multiple variable or property declarations placed on a single source line inside multi-line blocks, classes, or modules. |
| [`SVL-STY-016`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-016) | UnparenthesizedMacroArg | WARNING | style |  | Flags function-like expression macros whose formal parameters appear adjacent to operators in the macro body without enclosing parentheses. |
| [`SVL-STY-017`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-017) | UnusedIncludeDirective | INFO | style |  | Flags top-level `include directives outside package aggregation bodies whose included headers contribute no tokens or used macros. |
| [`SVL-STY-018`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-018) | ClassMemberOrdering | INFO | style |  | Enforces canonical class member ordering: typedefs and parameters, properties, constraints and covergroups, constructor new(), then methods. |
| [`SVL-STY-019`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-STY-019) | PortAndParamColumnAlignment | INFO | style |  | Flags port and parameter identifiers in tabular-aligned multi-line module or interface headers that drift out of column alignment. |
| [`SVL-STY-020`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SVL-STY-020) | FileClassNameMismatch | WARNING | style | MG-1.2 | Flags `include'd class files that define more than one top-level class, or whose one class is not named after the file (my_drv.svh holding my_driver). With one class per file, named after it, a class can be found from its name and reused on its own (MG-1.2). |
| `SVL-STY-100` | ConfigurableStyleEngine | WARNING | style |  | Parameterizable code style engine enforcing tab prohibitions, trailing whitespace limits, maximum line lengths, matching block end labels, and file naming. |
| `SVL-STY-101` | NoTabs | WARNING | style |  | Literal tab characters are not allowed (style.allow_tabs). (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |
| `SVL-STY-102` | NoTrailingWhitespace | WARNING | style |  | Lines must not end in whitespace (style.allow_trailing_whitespace). (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |
| `SVL-STY-103` | MaxLineLength | WARNING | style |  | Lines must not exceed style.max_line_length characters. (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |
| `SVL-STY-104` | MatchingEndLabel | WARNING | style |  | Blocks, routines and classes carry an end label that matches their name (style.mandatory_matching_end_label). (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |
| `SVL-STY-105` | FileMatchesClassName | WARNING | style |  | A file's base name matches the top-level class it defines. (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |
| `SVL-STY-106` | FileHeader | WARNING | style |  | Files start with a header matching style.file_header_pattern (style.require_file_header). (reported by `SVL-STY-100`) |

## Naming

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SVL-NAM-001`](../../testdata/rules/naming/SVL-NAM-001) | PackageNamingConvention | WARNING | style |  | Enforces that package identifiers end with '_pkg' (e.g., 'axi_pkg') to standardize namespaces. |
| [`SVL-NAM-002`](../../testdata/rules/naming/SVL-NAM-002) | InterfaceNamingConvention | WARNING | style |  | Enforces that interface identifiers end with '_if' (e.g., 'axi_if') to standardize interface definitions. |
| [`SVL-NAM-003`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-NAM-003) | TypedefNameSuffix | WARNING | style |  | Enforces naming conventions for typedefs: enums must end with '_e', and structs/data types must end with '_t'. |
| [`SVL-NAM-004`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-NAM-004) | MacroNamingConvention | INFO | style |  | Enforces UPPER_SNAKE_CASE naming on user-defined preprocessor macros (option: allow_prefix), exempting standard UVM and compiler macros. |
| [`SVL-NAM-005`](../../testdata/rules/style/SVL-NAM-005) | ConstraintNameSuffix | WARNING | style |  | Enforces a naming standard requiring all constraint blocks to end with '_c' suffix. |
| `SVL-NAM-100` | ConfigurableNamingEngine | WARNING | style |  | Parameterizable naming convention engine validating regex, prefix, suffix, and casing conventions across packages, interfaces, UVM classes, covergroups, and constraints. |
| `SVL-NAM-101` | PackageNaming | WARNING | style |  | Packages should end with '_pkg' for clean namespace identification. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-102` | InterfaceNaming | WARNING | style |  | Interfaces should end with '_if' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-103` | VirtualInterfaceNaming | WARNING | style |  | Virtual interface handles and typedefs should end with '_vif'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-104` | ClassNaming | WARNING | style |  | General classes should follow PascalCase naming conventions. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-105` | CovergroupNaming | WARNING | style |  | Covergroup declarations must end with '_cg' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-106` | CoverpointNaming | WARNING | style |  | Coverpoints should start with 'cp_' prefix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-107` | CrossNaming | WARNING | style |  | Cross coverages should start with 'cross_' or 'cx_' prefix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-108` | AssertionNaming | WARNING | style |  | Concurrent assertions should have labels ending with '_a' or '_assert'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-109` | ParameterNaming | WARNING | style |  | Parameters and constants should follow ALL_CAPS conventions. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-110` | TypedefEnumNaming | WARNING | style |  | Enum typedefs should end with '_e' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-111` | TypedefNaming | WARNING | style |  | User-defined typedefs should end with '_t' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `SVL-NAM-112` | ConstraintNaming | WARNING | style |  | Class constraint blocks should end with '_c' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| [`UVM-NAM-001`](../../testdata/rules/naming/UVM-NAM-001) | UvmComponentNamingConvention | WARNING | style |  | Enforces standard naming conventions for UVM components: classes derived from uvm_driver must end with '_driver', uvm_monitor with '_monitor', uvm_agent with '_agent', uvm_env with '_env', and uvm_test with '_test'. |
| [`UVM-NAM-002`](../../testdata/rules/style/UVM-NAM-002) | UvmClassTypeSuffix | WARNING | style |  | Enforces standard verification naming suffix conventions for classes extending UVM base components (e.g. _seq, _item, _driver, _monitor, _scoreboard, _env). |
| [`UVM-NAM-003`](../../testdata/rules/style/UVM-NAM-003) | ClassMemberPrefix | INFO | style |  | Enforces that member properties of uvm_component classes begin with 'm_' prefix to distinguish local member state from arguments and parameters. |
| [`UVM-NAM-004`](../../testdata/rules/style/UVM-NAM-004) | UvmCreateStringMismatch | WARNING | style |  | String argument passed to type_id::create() must match the receiving variable name. Mismatched instance names break uvm_config_db hierarchy paths and targeted overrides. |
| [`UVM-NAM-005`](../../testdata/rules/style/UVM-NAM-005) | UvmTlmPortSuffix | WARNING | style |  | Enforces standard UVM TLM port suffix naming conventions (_ap for analysis ports, _imp for imps, _export for exports, _port for ports, _fifo for TLM FIFOs). |
| `UVM-NAM-101` | UvmDriverNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM driver components must end with '_driver' or '_drv'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-102` | UvmMonitorNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM monitor components must end with '_monitor' or '_mon'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-103` | UvmSequencerNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM sequencers must end with '_sequencer' or '_sqr'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-104` | UvmSequenceNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM sequence classes must end with '_seq' or '_sequence'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-105` | UvmSequenceItemNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM transaction/sequence items must end with '_item' or '_seq_item'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-106` | UvmAgentNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM agents must end with '_agent' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-107` | UvmEnvNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM environments must end with '_env' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-108` | UvmTestNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM test classes must end with '_test' suffix. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-109` | UvmScoreboardNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM scoreboards must end with '_scoreboard' or '_scb'. (reported by `SVL-NAM-100`) |
